entries.name: Biting
entries: This weapon's damage becomes acid. Additionally, when you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with a weapon with the biting property, you can instead force the target to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with the weapon, or the biting number, whichever is lower). If you would have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the creature instead has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and if you would have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the creature instead has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target takes normal weapon damage and is subjected to any additional effects that would occur on a hit, and the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. If damage dealt by this weapon reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it must make a DC 13 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it dies immediately without making {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}. A disintegrated creature and everything unenhanced it is wearing and carrying are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. A creature destroyed in this way can not be revitalized.

entries.name: Bright
entries: This weapon's damage becomes fire, and its luminous property sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet while activated, instead of only dim light in a 5-foot radius. Additionally, when you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with a weapon with the bright property, you can instead force the target to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with the weapon, or the bright number, whichever is lower). If you would have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the creature instead has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and if you would have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the creature instead has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target takes normal weapon damage and is subjected to any additional effects that would occur on a hit, and the creature takes additional damage of the same type at the start of its next turn equal to your governing ability modifier.

entries.name: Brutal
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a weapon with the brutal property, you roll a number of additional weapon damage dice equal to the brutal number.

entries.name: Corruption
entries: This weapon's damage becomes necrotic, and it loses the luminous property if it has it. Additionally, when you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with a weapon with the corruption property, you can instead force the target to make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with the weapon, or the corruption number, whichever is lower). If you would have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the creature instead has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and if you would have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, the creature instead has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target takes normal weapon damage and is subjected to any additional effects that would occur on a hit, and the creature cannot regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Defensive
entries: When you make your first attack on your turn with a weapon with the defensive property, you can choose to suffer a penalty to attack and damage rolls with that weapon up to the defensive number. If you do so, you gain the same bonus to AC. These effects last until the start of your next turn, as long as you're holding the weapon.

entries.name: Dire
entries: Before you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a weapon with the dire property, you can choose to suffer a penalty to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} up to the dire number. If you do so and you hit with it, you gain an equivalent bonus to the damage roll.

entries.name: Disarming
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a weapon with the disarming property against a creature that is holding an object, you can attempt to disarm the target (no action required). If the target is no more than one size larger than you (your size or smaller if your weapon has the light property), it must succeed on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with the weapon) or it drops an object of your choice at its feet.

entries.name: {@spell Disintegrate|sw5e-phb}
entries: When a creature is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} by a weapon with the {@spell Disintegrate|sw5e-phb|disintegrate} property, it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, DC equal to the {@spell Disintegrate|sw5e-phb|disintegrate} number. On a failed save, it dies immediately without making {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}. A disintegrated creature and everything unenhanced it is wearing or carrying are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. A creature destroyed in this way can not be revitalized.

entries.name: Disruptive
entries: When a creature is forced to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} due to taking damage from a weapon with the disruptive property, the DC for the check equals 10 or the full damage taken, whichever number is higher, instead of only half.

entries.name: Keen
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a weapon with the keen property, the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range increases by an amount equal to the keen number.

entries.name: Mighty
entries: When making an attack with a mighty weapon, you use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

entries.name: Neuralizing
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon with the neuralizing property, you can force it to make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, DC equal to the neuralizing number. On a failed save, the creature takes an additional 1d4 psychic damage and becomes {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} of you until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Piercing
entries: Before you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a weapon with the piercing property, you can choose to gain a bonus to the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} up to the piercing number. If you do so and you hit with it, you suffer an equivalent penalty to the damage roll.

entries.name: Shocking
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon with the shocking property, you can force it to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, DC equal to the shocking number. On a failed save, the creature takes an additional 1d4 lightning damage and becomes {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Silent
entries: When you make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a weapon with the silent property while hidden, it does not automatically reveal your presence. Make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check contested by your targets' Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. On a success, you remain hidden.

entries.name: Smart
entries: This weapon ignores your Dexterity score and {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. Two numbers appear in parentheses with the property—the first is the weapon's Dexterity score, and the second is the weapon's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. The weapon uses these values instead of yours when you make attack and damage rolls with it. If you lack proficiency with the weapon, the weapon does not benefit from its {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Sonorous
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon with the sonorous property, you can force it to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, DC equal to the sonorous number. On a failed save, the creature takes an additional 1d4 sonic damage and becomes {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Switch
entries: A weapon with the switch property can deal an alternate type of damage. A damage value appears in parentheses appears with the property-the damage when the weapon uses its alternate damage type. On your turn, you can use your object interaction to change the weapon's damage type.

entries.name: Vicious
entries: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon with the vicious property and roll the maximum on a weapon damage die, you gain a bonus to damage equal to the vicious number.

entries.name: Absorptive
entries: When you are wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the absorptive property, damage that you take from weapons is reduced by an amount equal to the absorptive number. If this would reduce the damage to 0, the damage is instead reduced to 1.

entries.name: Agile
entries: While wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the agile property, your Dexterity score becomes equal to the agile number. If your Dexterity is already equal to or greater than the agile number, it has no effect on you.

entries.name: Anchor
entries: A {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the anchor property can be used to {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|provide cover}. As an action, you can anchor or recover the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. While anchored, you gain no benefit from a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, and it does not require the use of a hand. Instead, while anchored, a light {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} provides one-quarter {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, a medium {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} provides {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover}, and a heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} provides three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}.

entries.name: Avoidant
entries: When wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the avoidant property and a creature makes an attack against you, the {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range decreases by an amount equal to the avoidant number, to a minimum of 1.

entries.name: Barbed
entries: When you succeed on a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to initiate or maintain a grapple while wearing armor with the barbed property, the creature takes kinetic damage using the barbed damage (which appears in parentheses with the property) + your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Charging
entries: When you take damage while wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the charging property, you gain a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}. You can store a maximum number of charges equal to the charging number, and the charges last for 1 minute. The next time you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} while you have charges, you deal additional damage of the same type as the weapon's damage equal to the number of charges stored, and the charges are expended.

entries.name: Concealing
entries: While wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the concealing property, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Cumbersome
entries: While wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the cumbersome property, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by 5.

entries.name: Gauntleted
entries: While wearing armor with the gauntleted property, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal kinetic damage using the gauntleted damage (which appears in parentheses with the property) + your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Imbalanced
entries: When you are critically hit while wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the imbalanced property, you can't take reactions until the start of your next turn, and you gain no AC benefit from your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} against the next attack against you before the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Impermeable
entries: Armor with the impermeable property functions as an {@item Enviro-suit|sw5e-phb|enviro-suit}, {@item Flight suit|sw5e-phb|flight suit}, and water suit.

entries.name: Insulated
entries: When you make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against an effect that would deal ion or lightning damage while wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the insulated property, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of below the insulated number as the insulated number.

entries.name: Interlocking
entries: While wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the interlocking property within 5 feet of a friendly creature who is also wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the interlocking property, you can both use your reactions on either of your turns to interlock the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields}. While interlocked, both creatures gain a bonus to AC equal to the interlocking number. If at any point the creatures are more than 5 feet from each other, the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} immediately de-interlock, and this effect ends.

entries.name: Lambent
entries: While wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the lambent property, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate or deactivate the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s light. While active, the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. Additionally, Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made while the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s light is active that rely on sight have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Lightweight
entries: Armor and {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} with the lightweight property have their weight reduced by half.

entries.name: Magnetic
entries: While you are wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the magnetic property and a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} misses you by an amount less than or equal to your bonus to AC from your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, the attacking creature must make a Strength check, DC equal to the magnetic number. On a failed save, the creature's weapon adheres to the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. As an action, a creature can repeat this check. On a success, the weapon is freed.

entries.name: Obscured
entries: While wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the obscured property, electronic sensors and cameras have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks against you that rely on sight.

entries.name: Powered
entries: While wearing armor with the powered property, your Strength score becomes equal to the powered number. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the powered number, it has no effect on you.

entries.name: Reactive
entries: When you are wearing armor with the reactive property and a creature hits you with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you gain a bonus to AC against the next attack from that creature before the start of your next turn equal to the reactive number.

entries.name: Regulated
entries: When you are wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the regulated property and a creature rolls the maximum on a weapon damage die against you, they must reroll and use the new roll, even if the new roll is the maximum on the weapon damage die.

entries.name: Reinforced
entries: When you make a long jump while wearing armor with the reinforced property, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Responsive
entries: While you are wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the responsive property and an attack misses you by an amount less than or equal to your bonus to AC from your {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, you gain a bonus to AC against the next attack from that creature before the start of your next turn equal to the responsive number.

entries.name: Rigid
entries: While wearing armor with the rigid property, you add half your Dexterity modifier (rounded down), instead of your full Dexterity modifier, to Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} you make. If your Dexterity modifier is negative, you instead subtract the full modifier.

entries.name: Silent
entries: While wearing armor with the silent property, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks that rely on sound.

entries.name: Spiked
entries: When you succeed on a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check to shove or trip a creature while wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the spiked property, the creature takes kinetic damage using the spiked damage (which appears in parentheses with the property) + your Strength modifier. If you use a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the spiked property as an improvised weapon, the damage increases by one step (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}, or {@dice d8} to 2d4).

entries.name: Steadfast
entries: While wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the steadfast property, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength checks and Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being moved.

entries.name: Versatile
entries: A {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} with the versatile property can be used with one or two hands. While wielded in two hands, you gain an additional bonus to AC equal to the versatile number.

item.name: AB-75 Bo-Rifle
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this enhanced weapon. Additionally, while it is in staff mode, the save DC for its shocking property increases to 15.
{@i This version of the bo-rifle was exclusive to high-ranking members of the Honor Guard of Lasan.}

item.name: Absorptive Reinforcement
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the absorptive 1 property. If it already has the absorptive property, its absorptive property increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Absorptive Reinforcement Mk II
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the absorptive 2 property. If it already has the absorptive property, its absorptive number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Absorptive Reinforcement Mk III
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the absorptive 3 property. If it already has the absorptive property, its absorptive number increases to 3.

item.name: Accessing Cycler (Cracked)

item.name: Accessing Cycler (Flawed)

item.name: Accessing Cycler (Regular)

item.name: Accessing Motherboard (Simple)
entries: This item gains the accessing 1 property. If it already has the accessing property, its accessing number increases by 1, to a maximum of 6.

item.name: Accuracy Focus Mk I
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and a -1 penalty to damage rolls made with this weapon.

item.name: Accuracy Focus Mk II
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this weapon.

item.name: Accuracy Focus Mk III
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this weapon.

item.name: Accuracy Focus Mk IV
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this weapon.

item.name: {@feat Ace Pilot|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Basic)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Piloting} increases by one step (to trained, from trained to proficient, from proficient to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to mastery, from mastery to high mastery, or from high mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Ace Pilot|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Choice)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Piloting} increases by four steps (to mastery, from trained to high mastery, or from proficient to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Ace Pilot|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Elite)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Piloting} increases by five steps (to high mastery or from trained to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Ace Pilot|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Exquisite)
entries: You gain grand mastery in {@skill Piloting}.

item.name: {@feat Ace Pilot|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Favored)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Piloting} increases by three steps (to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from trained to mastery, from proficient to high mastery, or from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Ace Pilot|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Fine)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Piloting} increases by two steps (to proficient, from trained to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from proficient to mastery, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to high mastery, or from mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Acrobat|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Basic)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics} increases by one step (to trained, from trained to proficient, from proficient to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to mastery, from mastery to high mastery, or from high mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Acrobat|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Choice)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics} increases by four steps (to mastery, from trained to high mastery, or from proficient to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Acrobat|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Elite)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics} increases by five steps (to high mastery or from trained to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Acrobat|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Exquisite)
entries: You gain grand mastery in {@skill Acrobatics}.

item.name: {@feat Acrobat|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Favored)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics} increases by three steps (to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from trained to mastery, from proficient to high mastery, or from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Acrobat|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Fine)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Acrobatics} increases by two steps (to proficient, from trained to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from proficient to mastery, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to high mastery, or from mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: Active Camouflage Core
entries: As an action, you can activate this augmentation to cast the {@spell infiltrate|sw5e-phb} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} targeting yourself. Intelligence is your tech casting ability for this power, and if you cast it using this augmentation, it does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}.
{@b Side Effect:} While this augmentation is active, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by 10. Additionally, it fails to activate if you are submerged in water or other liquids.
{@i This internal augmentation can be activated to project a distortion field that bends visual light.}

item.name: Adapted Armor
entries: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly from the options below.
{@i Those foolhardy enough to not treat a hostile planet as worthy a foe as the ones carrying blasters don't often live long enough to boast about it.}

item.name: Adegan Crystal (Chipped)
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon.

item.name: Adegan Crystal (Cracked)
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls and a -1 penalty to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this weapon.

item.name: Adegan Crystal (Flawed)
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon.

item.name: Adegan Crystal (Regular)
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon.

item.name: Agile Armoring Mk I
entries: This armor gains the agile 11 property. If it already has the agile property, its agile number increases by one step (from 11 to 13, 13 to 15, 15 to 17, 17 to 19, or 19 to 21).

item.name: Agile Armoring Mk II
entries: This armor gains the agile 13 property. If it already has the agile property, its agile number increases by two steps (from 11 to 15, 13 to 17, 15 to 19, or 17 to 21).

item.name: Agile Armoring Mk III
entries: This armor gains the agile 15 property. If it already has the agile property, its agile number increases by three steps (from 11 to 17, 13 to 19, or 15 to 21).

item.name: Agile Armoring Mk IV
entries: This armor gains the agile 17 property. If it already has the agile property, its agile number increases by four steps (from 11 to 19 or 13 to 21).

item.name: Agile Armoring Mk V
entries: This armor gains the agile 19 property. If it already has the agile property, its agile number increases by five steps (from 11 to 21).

item.name: Agile Armoring Mk VI
entries: This armor gains the agile 21 property. If it already has the agile property, its agile number increases to 21.

item.name: Alacrity Adrenal (Basic)
entries: As an action, you can administer this adrenal to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one adrenal at a time.

item.name: Alacrity Adrenal (Champion)
entries: As an action, you can administer this adrenal to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 60 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one adrenal at a time.

item.name: Alacrity Adrenal (Exceptional)
entries: As an action, you can administer this adrenal to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 50 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one adrenal at a time.

item.name: Alacrity Adrenal (Fine)
entries: As an action, you can administer this adrenal to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one adrenal at a time.

item.name: Alacrity Adrenal (Improved)
entries: As an action, you can administer this adrenal to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 30 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one adrenal at a time.

item.name: Alacrity Adrenal (Superior)
entries: As an action, you can administer this adrenal to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 40 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one adrenal at a time.

item.name: Ammo-feed belt
entries: This belt has slots to hold 60 {@item slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridges}, and can be connected to directly fuel a single {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon that uses {@item slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridges}. Once per turn, if the powered weapon would be reloaded, it can be done without using an action using any ammunition in the belt. Connecting or disconnecting a weapon takes an action. Replacing 10 {@item slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridges} takes an action.

item.name: Amplifying Barrel (Basic)
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls and a -1 penalty to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this weapon.

item.name: Amplifying Barrel (Fine)
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon.

item.name: Amplifying Barrel (Improved)
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon.

item.name: Amplifying Barrel (Superior)
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon.

item.name: Amplifying Channel (Ascendancy)
entries: This item gains the amplifying 3 property. If it already has the amplifying property, its amplifying number increases to 3.

item.name: Amplifying Channel (Fighting)
entries: This item gains the amplifying 1 property. If it already has the amplifying property, its amplifying number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Amplifying Channel (Mastery)
entries: This item gains the amplifying 2 property. If it already has the amplifying property, its amplifying number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Amplifying Processor (Ascendancy)
entries: This item gains the amplifying 3 property. If it already has the amplifying property, its amplifying number increases to 3.

item.name: Amplifying Processor (Fighting)
entries: This item gains the amplifying 1 property. If it already has the amplifying property, its amplifying number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Amplifying Processor (Mastery)
entries: This item gains the amplifying 2 property. If it already has the amplifying property, its amplifying number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Analysis Protocol
entries: You know the {@spell detect enhancement|sw5e-phb} and {@spell toxin scan|sw5e-phb} {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. You can cast each power once per day. Intelligence is your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for these powers. You do not require use of a {@item wristpad|sw5e-phb} for these powers.

item.name: Andris
entries: Refined andris crystal, a spice mined most commonly on Sevarcos II, sharpens a creature's mind when smoked. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d3} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 10 minutes, during which they must roll a {@dice d3} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Andris (Fine)
entries: Refined andris crystal, a spice mined most commonly on Sevarcos II, sharpens a creature's mind when smoked. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d4} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 1 hour, during which they must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Andris (High Quality)
entries: Refined andris crystal, a spice mined most commonly on Sevarcos II, sharpens a creature's mind when smoked. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next 10 minutes, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d8} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 4 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d8} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 20 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Andris (Potent)
entries: Refined andris crystal, a spice mined most commonly on Sevarcos II, sharpens a creature's mind when smoked. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next hour, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d10} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 4 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d10} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 22 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Andris (Pure)
entries: Refined andris crystal, a spice mined most commonly on Sevarcos II, sharpens a creature's mind when smoked. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next hour, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d12} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 24 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 8 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d12} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 24 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Andris (Uncut)
entries: Refined andris crystal, a spice mined most commonly on Sevarcos II, sharpens a creature's mind when smoked. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next 10 minutes, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d6} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 1 hour, during which they must roll a {@dice d6} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 18 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: {@feat Animal Handler|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Basic)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling} increases by one step (to trained, from trained to proficient, from proficient to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to mastery, from mastery to high mastery, or from high mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Animal Handler|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Choice)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling} increases by four steps (to mastery, from trained to high mastery, or from proficient to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Animal Handler|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Elite)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling} increases by five steps (to high mastery or from trained to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Animal Handler|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Exquisite)
entries: You gain grand mastery in {@skill Animal Handling}.

item.name: {@feat Animal Handler|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Favored)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling} increases by three steps (to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from trained to mastery, from proficient to high mastery, or from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Animal Handler|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Fine)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling} increases by two steps (to proficient, from trained to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from proficient to mastery, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to high mastery, or from mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: Aratech Echo Belt
entries: While you wear this belt with its field on, Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to see you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide, as the belt funnels light around you. Activating or deactivating the belt takes an action.
{@i The success of this high-end stealth field generator emboldened Aratech to branch out into other hardware.}

item.name: Aratech Recycler Core Mk II
entries: When you use the burst feature of this weapon, you can choose to include up to 2 additional creatures within 5 feet of any affected space to also be affected the burst, if they were not already.

Once per turn, when you deal damage with this weapon, your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet until the start of your next turn, and the damaged creature can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} against you for the rest of your turn.

item.name: Aratech Sound Dampening Boots
entries: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks that rely on moving silently.
{@i Before their repulsorcraft hit it big, Aratech honed its edge in the stealth field generator market.}

item.name: Armament and Defense Library
entries: You gain proficiency in all simple and {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon}, all armor, and the {@skill Piloting} skill. Additionally, when you make an Intelligence check to recall or discern information about a weapon, piece of armor, or a military vehicle that this library contains information on, you are considered proficient in the check.

{@b Side Effect:} This aggressively effective library can make it difficult to focus in stressful situations. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} while concentrating on a power.

{@i This small and unassuming electronic module installed in the parietal lobe contains a massive library of information pertaining to weapons, armor, droids, and every other defense system known to the galaxy at large. Even rare or obscure pieces of technology are described here, offering a unique perspective on the universe - if you can handle it.}

item.name: Armor (Champion)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. Additionally, while wearing this armor, damage you take is reduced by 2. If this would reduce the damage to 0, the damage is instead reduced to 1.

item.name: Armor (Exceptional)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. Additionally, while wearing this armor, damage you take is reduced by 1. If this would reduce the damage to 0, the damage is instead reduced to 1.

item.name: Armor (Fine)
entries: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

item.name: Armor (Improved)
entries: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

item.name: Armor (Superior)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

item.name: Armor Chassis (Advanced)
entries: This modifiable armor chassis comes with vacant modification slots for armor modifications, as well as one augment slot. It can house modifications of advanced rarity or lower.

item.name: Armor Chassis (Artifact)
entries: This modifiable armor chassis comes with vacant modification slots for armor modifications, as well as two augment slots. It can house modifications of artifact rarity or lower.

item.name: Armor Chassis (Legendary)
entries: This modifiable armor chassis comes with vacant modification slots for armor modifications, as well as two augment slots. It can house modifications of legendary rarity or lower.

item.name: Armor Chassis (Premium)
entries: This modifiable armor chassis comes with vacant modification slots for armor modifications. It can house modifications of premium rarity or lower.

item.name: Armor Chassis (Prototype)
entries: This modifiable armor chassis comes with vacant modification slots for armor modifications, as well as one augment slot. It can house modifications of prototype rarity or lower.

item.name: Armor Chassis (Standard)
entries: This modifiable armor chassis comes with vacant modification slots for armor modifications. It can house modifications of standard rarity.

item.name: Artificially Intelligent
entries: You install an artificial intelligence into this armor. While wearing this armor, when you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, this armor's artificial intelligence can take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action.
You can use this feature twice. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

item.name: Atmospheric Decanting Vessel
entries: This metal jug appears to be able to hold a gallon of liquid and weighs 12 pounds whether full or empty.

You can use an action and name one liquid from the table below to cause the jug to produce the chosen liquid. Afterward, you can open the jug as an action and pour that liquid out, up to 2 gallons per minute. The maximum amount of liquid the jug can produce depends on the liquid you named.
Once the jug starts producing a liquid, it can't produce a different one, or more of one that has reached its maximum, until the next dawn.
{@i Most liquids one might desire curiously only involve a handful of elements. This device collects a reservoir of them to recreate a selection of such liquids on demand.}

item.name: Automated Adrenal Package
entries: Once on your turn, you can activate this implant to gain the effects of an adrenal (no action required). This effect lasts for one minute, or until a different adrenal is chosen. You can choose from the following types of adrenals:

items: {@b Strength Adrenal:} You gain a +1 bonus to the damage rolls of melee weapon attacks, and your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.
{@b Alacrity Adrenal:} You gain a +1 bonus to the damage rolls of ranged weapon attacks, and your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet.
{@b Stamina Adrenal:} You gain 2 temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} and a +2 bonus to Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries: {@b Side Effect:} You can no longer benefit from other adrenals.

{@i This clear plasti-polymer implant has an appearance vaguely resembling a multi-limbed cephalopod, and must be carefully installed by a master cybertech. It attaches by wrapping around the medulla, and produces a variety of combat adrenals for its user's consumption. It also performs blood-cleansing work to reduce the liver damage (for species that have a liver) caused by long-term adrenal use.}

item.name: Avoidant Reinforcement
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the avoidant 1 property. If it already has the avoidant property, its avoidant number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Avoidant Reinforcement Mk II
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the avoidant 2 property. If it already has the avoidant property, its avoidant number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Avoidant Reinforcement Mk III
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the avoidant 3 property. If it already has the avoidant property, its avoidant number increases to 3.

item.name: Avoidant Weave (Basic)
entries: This clothing gains the avoidant 1 armor property. If it already has the avoidant armor property, its avoidant number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Avoidant Weave (Choice)
entries: This clothing gains the avoidant 2 armor property. If it already has the avoidant armor property, its avoidant number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Avoidant Weave (Exquisite)
entries: This clothing gains the avoidant 3 armor property. If it already has the avoidant armor property, its avoidant number increases to 3.

item.name: Balanced Shielding
entries: {@i {@b Prerequiste:} {@item Shield|sw5e-phb}}
This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} loses the imbalanced property.

item.name: Ballistic Polymer
entries: While you have temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, kinetic and energy damage you take is reduced by an amount equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded up).

item.name: Ballistic Polymer (Exceptional)
entries: While you have temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, kinetic and energy damage you take is reduced by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

item.name: Bansche Advanced 2ZBc
entries: When you spend tech points and deal damage with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} cast through this {@item wristpad|sw5e-phb}, you deal additional damage equal to the number of tech points spent.

item.name: Bansche Purifier MENAD Pro Mk I
entries: When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with this {@item wristpad|sw5e-phb} that gives you a bonus to AC or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, you can increase that bonus by +1.

item.name: Baragwin {@skill Stealth} Unit
entries: While wearing this belt, you can turn on its stealth field to cause yourself to become {@condition invisible|sw5e-phb}. While you are {@condition invisible|sw5e-phb}, anything you are carrying or wearing is {@condition invisible|sw5e-phb} with you. You become visible when you turn off the field. Turning the field on or off requires an action.

Deduct the time you are {@condition invisible|sw5e-phb}, in increments of 1 minute, from the belt's maximum duration of 2 hours. After 2 hours of use, the belt ceases to function. For every uninterrupted period of 12 hours the belt goes unused, it regains 1 hour of use.
{@i Those Baragwin who sought to turn their telepathic empathy into an asset for bounty hunting needed something special to overcome the drawbacks of their lumbering frames.}

item.name: Barbed Armoring
entries: This armor gains the barbed ({@dice 1d4}) property. If it already has the barbed property, the barbed damage increases by one step (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, or from {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}).

item.name: Barbed Armoring Mk II
entries: This armor gains the barbed ({@dice 1d6}) property. If it already has the barbed property, the barbed damage increases by two steps (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d8}).

item.name: Barbed Armoring Mk III
entries: This armor gains the barbed ({@dice 1d8}) property. If it already has the barbed property, the barbed damage increases to {@dice d8}.

item.name: Battle Adrenal Mk I
entries: As an action, you can administer this adrenal to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, when the target takes the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, it can make one additional attack (no action required). This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one adrenal at a time.

item.name: Battle Adrenal Mk II
entries: As an action, you can administer this adrenal to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, when the target takes the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, it can make two additional attacks (no action required). This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one adrenal at a time.

item.name: Bayonet
entries: You affix a short blade to the barrel of this weapon, allowing you to make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with it. The blade is a melee weapon with {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property} that you are proficient with, and deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage.

item.name: Beemon Cardio-Regulator
entries: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this choker. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher.
{@i Demand for Beemon Laboratories' implants streches even to those too sickly to use them without assistance from another of their fine products.}

item.name: Berserker Defensive Augment
entries: You learn an additional Berserker Instinct option.

item.name: Berserker Offensive Augment
entries: Your Rage damage bonus increases by 1, and when you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit}, you can roll one additional weapon damage die and add the result to the total.

item.name: Bioenhancement Matrix Mk I
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to your level, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

item.name: Bioenhancement Matrix Mk II
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level, and it increases by 2 every time you gain a level.

item.name: Bioenhancement Matrix Mk III
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to three times your level, and it increases by 3 every time you gain a level.

item.name: Biometric Safety Measures
entries: A security system is installed into the hilt of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}. When a creature other than you attempts to activate your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, the activation fails. Additionally, the creature attempting to activate it must make a DC 13 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d10} lightning damage and is {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the end of its next turn. On a successful save the creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}. On a success or failure, the creature then drops the weapon.

item.name: Biting Crystal (Adept)
entries: This weapon gains the biting 16 property. If it already has the biting property, its biting number increases by 4, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Biting Crystal (Ancient)
entries: This weapon gains the biting 18 property. If it already has the biting property, its biting number increases to 18.

item.name: Biting Crystal (Apprentice)
entries: This weapon gains the biting 14 property. If it already has the biting property, its biting number increases by 2, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Biting Crystal (Journeyman)
entries: This weapon gains the biting 15 property. If it already has the biting property, its biting number increases by 3, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Biting Crystal (Master)
entries: This weapon gains the biting 17 property. If it already has the biting property, its biting number increases by 5, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Biting Crystal (Novice)
entries: This weapon gains the biting 13 property. If it already has the biting property, its biting number increases by 1, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} Chassis (Advanced)
entries: This modifiable {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} modifications, as well as one augment slot. It can house modifications of advanced rarity or lower.

item.name: {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} Chassis (Artifact)
entries: This modifiable {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} modifications, as well as two augment slots. It can house modifications of artifact rarity or lower.

item.name: {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} Chassis (Legendary)
entries: This modifiable {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} modifications, as well as two augment slots. It can house modifications of legendary rarity or lower.

item.name: {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} Chassis (Premium)
entries: This modifiable {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} modifications. It can house modifications of premium rarity or lower.

item.name: {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} Chassis (Prototype)
entries: This modifiable {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} modifications, as well as one augment slot. It can house modifications of prototype rarity or lower.

item.name: {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} Chassis (Standard)

item.name: {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} Integration
entries: You can now integrate a single simple or martial {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} into your droid chassis. Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can insert and integrate this {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} into your frame. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can open or close a small hatch located somewhere on your droid body, permitting you to wield and fire the weapon normally when you want to attack with it. While the hatch is open, your hands are not considered occupied by this {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}. All other rules and conditions apply normally as if you were wielding this {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} in either one or two hands (your choice).

item.name: Blueprint (Advanced)
entries: This blueprint contains information regarding the raw and rare materials, tools, and steps required to craft an item of advanced rarity. Over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, a character can attempt to learn the blueprint. If they do so, they must make a DC 22 Intelligence check with the appropriate tools. On a success, the blueprint for the item is learned. On a failure, the blueprint is not learned, and the character must wait 24 hours before they can try again.
{@i Blueprints contain the secrets of how to craft items of a more complex nature.}

item.name: Bolas (Champion)
entries: A Large or smaller creature hit by a bolas is {@condition restrained|sw5e-phb} until it is freed. A bolas has no effect on formless or Huge or larger creatures. A creature can use its action to make a DC 18 Dexterity check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The bolas has an AC of 15, 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, immunity to all damage not dealt by melee weapons, and {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to damage dealt by unenhanced melee weapons. Destroying the bolas frees the creature without harming it and immediately ends the bolas's effects. While a creature is {@condition restrained|sw5e-phb} by a bolas, you can make no further attacks with it.

Due to their unwieldy nature, bolas make ineffective melee weapons. Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with them are made at {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

item.name: Boots of Bounding
entries: This item can hold a number of charges equal to half your fighter level (rounded up). When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, this item regains all missing charges. On your turn, you can expend 1 or more charges to engage the rocket boosters and leap to a space you can see. For each {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} spent, you can move up to 10 feet. Any {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} you provoke with this movement are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

When you reach 5th level in fighter, when you use your Action Surge feature, your movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is doubled for the turn, you gain a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} until the end of your turn, though you fall if you end your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} in the air and nothing else is holding you aloft, and {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} made against you this turn have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.
When you reach 11th level in fighter, when you use your Indomitable feature, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll.
When you reach 17th level in fighter, once per round, when you miss with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can repeat the attack (no action required).
{@i These red and black boots come with integrated rocket boosters.}

item.name: Boots of Hiding
entries: While wearing these boots, creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made to track your steps.

Additionally, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to cause the boots to leave behind no footprints for 1 minute. When you do, another set of similar footprints appear on the ground that lead in random directions. These footprints last for 8 hours and travel up to 300 feet. A successful DC 14 Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check reveals that the footprints are false. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

item.name: {@feat Brawny|sw5e-phb} Arm Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces an arm.

When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength using only this arm, your Strength score is treated as 15. When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength using more than just this arm, you take the average of the arm's Strength score and your own.

{@b Side Effect:} When you roll a 1 on an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength with this arm, it seizes up, becoming unusable until the start of your next turn.
{@i These arm replacements are popular with the less exercise-inclined.}

item.name: {@feat Brawny|sw5e-phb} Pattern (Basic)

item.name: {@feat Brawny|sw5e-phb} Pattern (Elite)

item.name: {@feat Brawny|sw5e-phb} Pattern (Exquisite)

{@i This belt further increases a users physical power with pneumaticized assistance joists and a repulsorfield microgenerator.}

item.name: Camtono
entries: A camtono is a secured, handle container used for transporting valuable goods. A camtono comes with one key. Without the key, unlocking the camtono requires a DC 15 {@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit} check to force open. It stores 5 lb., not exceeding 1/4 cubic foot, has an AC of 10, and 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. Destroying the camtono risks damaging any goods stored inside.

item.name: Cape of the Orator
entries: This item can hold a number of charges equal to half your scholar level (rounded up). When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, this item regains all missing charges. When your superiority die is rolled, you can expend one {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} to reroll the die and choose either roll.

When you reach 5th level in scholar, you can maintain two targets of your Critical Analysis feature, instead of one. If you use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} a third target, you choose which Critical Analysis ends.
When you reach 11th level in scholar, when you use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to use your Critical Analysis feature, you can target two creatures, instead of just one.
When you reach 17th level in scholar, you can take a third {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} each round. You can only take one {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} per turn.
{@i This color-shifting cloak is immune to wrinkles and always has a pressed appearance.}

item.name: Celerity Leg Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces both legs.

When determining your bonus to AC and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} from Dexterity, your Dexterity score is treated as 15. Additionally, you can substitute this score for your own whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} that uses your legs. If your Dexterity score is already equal to or greater than 15, it has no effect on you.

{@b Side Effect:} When you roll a 1 an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Dexterity that involves these legs, they seize up, reducing your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} to 0 until the start of your next turn.
{@i This leg replacement is common for those travelers interested in making a quick getaway.}

item.name: Celerity Oscillator

For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d3} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. item.name: Circlet of Persistence
entries: This item can hold a number of charges equal to half your consular level (rounded up). When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, this item regains all missing charges. When you would use a Force-Empowered Casting option, you can expend charges instead of force points.
When you reach 5th level in consular, when you use your Force Recovery feature, you can add both your Wisdom and Charisma modifier to the number of force points regained, instead of just one.
When you reach 11th level in consular, you can ignore the prerequisites for {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that are lower level than your Max Power Level.

When you reach 17th level in consular, when you make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) if it doesn't already include that modifier.
