When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can spend charges to reroll any number of dice and use either result.

When you reach 5th level in operative, while the hood is drawn, creatures can't see within the hood's confines unless you choose to allow it, you are in a source of enhanced light, or the creatures possess {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}. Additionally, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to all damage until the end of your first turn.

When you reach 11th level in operative, when you use your Uncanny {@action Dodge|sw5e-phb} feature, an illusory duplicate of yourself appears in your space until the start of your next turn. The first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made against you before the start of your next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

When you reach 17th level in operative, when you are conscious and fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can choose to instead succeed. Once you've done so, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can do so again.
{@i The color of this hood shifts between light gray and black depending on light.}

item.name: {@item Credit|sw5e-phb} chip
entries: The {@item Credit|sw5e-phb|credit} chip is a small, flat card that features a security code and algorithm memory stripes. The chip can be preloaded with a specified number of {@item credit|sw5e-phb|credits}, or it can draw directly from a specific account held by the user. The {@item Credit|sw5e-phb|credit} chip can be accessed with a pin, or by a DC 15 {@item Slicer's kit|sw5e-phb|Slicer's kit} check.

item.name: Crossguard Hilt
entries: This weapon gains the defensive 1 property. If it already has the defensive property, its defensive number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Crossguard Hilt (Champion)
entries: This weapon gains the defensive 3 property. If it already has the defensive property, its defensive number increases to 3.

item.name: Crossguard Hilt (Superior)
entries: This weapon gains the defensive 2 property. If it already has the defensive property, its defensive number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Cryo cell
entries: A cryo cell is a specialized {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} for use with {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons that deal acid, energy, fire, ion, or sonic damage. The loaded weapon deals cold damage instead of its normal damage type, and when you hit with a shot the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d4} cold damage and gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed}. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, that creature is frozen in {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} for 1 hour.

item.name: Crystalizing Amplifier (Dueling)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +2 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Crystalizing Amplifier (Fighting)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Crystalizing Amplifier (Mastery)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +3 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Crystalizing Amplifier (Training)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to melee force attacks and a -1 penalty to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Crystalizing Rangefinder (Dueling)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +2 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Crystalizing Rangefinder (Fighting)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Crystalizing Rangefinder (Mastery)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +3 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Crystalizing Rangefinder (Training)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to ranged force attacks and a -1 penalty to melee force attacks.

item.name: Czerka Attenuating Pulsator
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} or reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a ranged attack using this weapon, you can regain a number of tech points equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of one, no action required).  Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

item.name: Czerka Elite Pro Mk V
entries: When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with this {@item wristpad|sw5e-phb} and at least one creature fails its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist its effects, you gain a {@dice d12} that you can roll and add to the damage or healing of a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast. This die lasts for 1 minute, and you can only have one at a time.

item.name: Czerka Variable Claw-Hand Multitool
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can transform this claw-hand into one of the following items of your choice, or back its default claw-hand state. While your claw-hand is transformed, you are considered to be proficient in the item it is replicating, if you are not already:

items: {@item Security kit|sw5e-phb}
Artisan tools (one set, chosen at the time this augmentation is installed)
{@item Commlink|sw5e-phb}
{@item Fusion cutter|sw5e-phb}
{@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb} (with 50 feet of fibercord cable)
{@item Hydrospanner|sw5e-phb}
{@item Traumakit|sw5e-phb}
{@item Repair kit|sw5e-phb}
{@item Hidden blade|sw5e-phb} {@i (martial vibroweapon)}
{@item Hold out|sw5e-phb} {@i (simple blaster)}
{@item Medium shield generator|sw5e-phb} {@i (medium armor)}

entries: For items that have charges such as the {@item repair kit|sw5e-phb}, you regain all expended charges at the end of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. For items that use {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}, you can reload those with {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} normally.
{@b Side Effect:} Once this hand replacement has been installed, you can no longer wield weapons in this hand other than those this augmentation can transform into.
{@i The CVCM hand replacement appears to be a simple claw, but it contains a startling variety of tools, transforming to become whatever gadget is needed at the moment.}

item.name: Damind Crystal (Flawed)
entries: When you deal damage with this weapon, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add the result to the total.

item.name: Damind Crystal (Flawless)
entries: When you deal damage with this weapon, you can roll a {@dice d8} and add the result to the total.

item.name: Damind Crystal (Perfect)
entries: When you deal damage with this weapon, you can roll a {@dice d10} and add the result to the total.

item.name: Damind Crystal (Regular)
entries: When you deal damage with this weapon, you can roll a {@dice d6} and add the result to the total.

item.name: Daring {@feat Acrobat|sw5e-phb} Package
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 1, and your maximum for this score increases by 1. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
{@b Side Effect:} One ability score other than Dexterity (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.
{@i This implant drastically increases your fine motor skills and reaction times.}

item.name: Darksaber
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this enhanced {@item lightsaber|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, the weapon ignores {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to energy damage.

When you attack a creature that has at least one head with this weapon and roll a 20 on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb|survive} without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to energy damage, doesn't have or need a head, has legendary actions, or the GM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra {@damage 6d6} energy damage from the hit.

{@i The Darksaber was an ancient and unique black-bladed lightsaber created by Tarre Vizsla, the first Mandalorian ever inducted into the Jedi Order. It features a distinctly Mandalorian hilt and an ominous black blade.}

item.name: {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb} Goggles
entries: While wearing these goggles, you have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, these goggles increase its range by 30 feet.

item.name: {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb} Visor
entries: While wearing this armor, you have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, this modification increases its range by 30 feet.

item.name: Dart (Average)
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this enhanced {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} {@item dart|sw5e-phb}, which deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage on a hit. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the dart has been fired, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Dart (Deadly)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this enhanced {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} {@item dart|sw5e-phb}, which deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage on a hit. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the dart has been fired, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Dart (Devastating)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and deal an additional {@damage 1d10} damage with this enhanced {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} {@item dart|sw5e-phb}, which deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage on a hit. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the dart has been fired, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Dart (Lethal)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and deal an additional {@damage 1d8} damage with this enhanced {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} {@item dart|sw5e-phb}, which deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage on a hit. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the dart has been fired, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Dart (Major)
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this enhanced {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} {@item dart|sw5e-phb}, which deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage on a hit. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the dart has been fired, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: {@item Datacron|sw5e-phb} Mk I
entries: This {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} contains a single at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. After tinkering with the {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} for at least 2 hours, a techcaster with a Max Power Level of 1st or higher can make a DC 10 {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check with proficiency. On a success, they learn the contained {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, which does not count against their {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. On a failure, the power is not learned and the techcaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Datacrons are encrypted storage devices that contain an interactive projection, and are used to store high-value, sensitive information.}

item.name: {@item Datacron|sw5e-phb} Mk II
entries: This {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} contains a single 1st-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. After tinkering with the {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} for at least 4 hours, a techcaster with a Max Power Level of 1st or higher can make a DC 14 {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check with proficiency. On a success, they learn the contained {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, which does not count against their {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. On a failure, the power is not learned and the techcaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Datacrons are encrypted storage devices that contain an interactive projection, and are used to store high-value, sensitive information.}

item.name: {@item Datacron|sw5e-phb} Mk III
entries: This {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} contains a single 3rd-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, or multiple powers of 1st-2nd level with a combined level no greater than 3. After tinkering with the {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} for at least 8 hours, a techcaster with a Max Power Level of 3rd or higher can make a DC 18 {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check with proficiency. On a success, they learn the contained {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}(s), which does not count against their {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. On a failure, the power is not learned and the techcaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Datacrons are encrypted storage devices that contain an interactive projection, and are used to store high-value, sensitive information.}

item.name: {@item Datacron|sw5e-phb} Mk IV
entries: This {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} contains a single 5th-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, or multiple powers of 1st-4th level with a combined level no greater than 5. After tinkering with the {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} for at least 16 hours, a techcaster with a Max Power Level of 5th or higher can make a DC 22 {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check with proficiency. On a success, they learn the contained {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}(s), which does not count against their {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. On a failure, the power is not learned and the techcaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Datacrons are encrypted storage devices that contain an interactive projection, and are used to store high-value, sensitive information.}

item.name: {@item Datacron|sw5e-phb} Mk V
entries: This {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} contains a single 7th-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, or multiple powers of 1st-6th level with a combined level no greater than 7. After tinkering with the {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} for at least 40 hours, a techcaster with a Max Power Level of 7th or higher can make a DC 26 {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check with proficiency. On a success, they learn the contained {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}(s), which does not count against their {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. On a failure, the power is not learned and the techcaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Datacrons are encrypted storage devices that contain an interactive projection, and are used to store high-value, sensitive information.}

item.name: {@item Datacron|sw5e-phb} Mk VI
entries: This {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} contains a single 9th-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, or multiple powers of 1st-8th level with a combined level no greater than 9. After tinkering with the {@item datacron|sw5e-phb} for at least 80 hours, a techcaster with a Max Power Level of 9th or higher can make a DC 30 {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check with proficiency. On a success, they learn the contained {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}(s), which does not count against their {@book Tech Powers Known|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. On a failure, the power is not learned and the techcaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Datacrons are encrypted storage devices that contain an interactive projection, and are used to store high-value, sensitive information.}

item.name: Deafening calibrator
entries: As an action, you can apply this calibrator to one {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} or pair of handwraps within 5 feet, granting it a +1 bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Additionally, for the duration, the weapon gains the sonorous 13 property. If it already has the sonorous property, its sonorous number increases by 1, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Deafening cell
entries: A deafening cell is a specialized {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} for use with {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons that deal acid, energy, fire, ion, or sonic damage. The loaded weapon deals sonic damage instead of its normal damage type, and when you hit with a shot the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d6} sonic damage and is {@condition deafened|sw5e-phb} until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition deafened|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Deafening collimator
entries: As an action, you can apply this collimator to one {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} within 5 feet, granting it a +1 bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Additionally, for the duration, the weapon gains the sonorous 13 property. If it already has the sonorous property, its sonorous number increases by 1, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Deafening dart
entries: This {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} ammunition deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage on a hit. Also on a hit, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking {@damage 1d4} sonic damage on a failed save.
Additionally, on a failed save, a creature is {@condition deafened|sw5e-phb} for 1 minute. At the end of an affected creature's turn, it can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Defel Mimicker
entries: While you wear this belt, it casts a shadow that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while you are {@condition incapacitated|sw5e-phb}, {@condition restrained|sw5e-phb}, or otherwise unable to move.
{@i The only visible trace of this stealth field generator's user is a vague shadow, much like the Defel themselves.}

item.name: Defensive Guard
entries: This weapon gains the defensive 1 property. If it already has the defensive property, its defensive number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Defensive Guard (Champion)
entries: This weapon gains the defensive 3 property. If it already has the defensive property, its defensive number increases to 3.

item.name: Defensive Guard (Superior)
entries: This weapon gains the defensive 2 property. If it already has the defensive property, its defensive number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Detachable Eye
entries: This augmentation replaces an eye.

As an action, you can remove or replace this eye. While removed, the eye sprouts eight small legs, has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 15 feet, an AC of 10, and 1 hit point. As an action on each of your turns, you can move the eye up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} as long as it is within 30 feet of you. You can see through both the detached eye and your remaining eye at the same time, or you can use your action to see through only one eye or the other.

{@b Side Effect:} While the eye is removed, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight beyond 5 feet.
{@i This eye replacement is a favored tool for the augmented spy.}

item.name: Detachable Hand
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

As an action, you can attach or detach this hand. While detached, the hand has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 15 feet, an AC of 10, and 1 hit point. As an action on each of your turns, you can control the hand as long as it is within 30 feet of you. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a container. You can move the hand up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} each time you use it.
{@b Side Effect:} This hand can no longer wield items that weigh more than 7 lbs.
{@i This unique hand replacement is a favored option for those looking into places they aren't welcome.}

item.name: Deuterium-pyro
entries: This alcoholic beverage, favored amongst ruffians, features a terrible flavor and strong aftertaste. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d3} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 10 minutes, during which they must roll a {@dice d3} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 14 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Deuterium-pyro (Aged)
entries: This alcoholic beverage, favored amongst ruffians, features a terrible flavor and strong aftertaste. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next 10 minutes, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d8} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 4 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d8} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 20 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Deuterium-pyro (Fine)
entries: This alcoholic beverage, favored amongst ruffians, features a terrible flavor and strong aftertaste. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d4} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 1 hour, during which they must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. For the next 10 minutes, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d6} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 1 hour, during which they must roll a {@dice d6} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 18 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Deuterium-pyro (Reserve)
entries: This alcoholic beverage, favored amongst ruffians, features a terrible flavor and strong aftertaste. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next hour, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d10} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 4 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d10} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 22 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Deuterium-pyro (Special)
entries: This alcoholic beverage, favored amongst ruffians, features a terrible flavor and strong aftertaste. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next hour, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d12} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 8 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d12} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 24 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Dexterity Augment  (Champion)
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your maximum for this score increases by 2.

item.name: Dexterity Augment (Basic)
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 1. One ability score other than Dexterity (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.

item.name: Dexterity Augment (Exceptional)
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your maximum for this score increases by 1.

item.name: Dexterity Augment (Fine)
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 1.

item.name: Dexterity Augment (Improved)
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 1, and your maximum for this score increases by 1. One ability score other than Dexterity (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.

item.name: Dexterity Augment (Superior)
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 1, and your maximum for this score increases by 1.

item.name: Dexterity Enhancement (Basic)
entries: Your Dexterity score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
{@b Side Effect:} One ability score other than Dexterity (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.

item.name: Dexterity Stim (Basic)

item.name: Electrifying Oscillator
entries: When you hit with the weapon, you can create an electronic burst. Each creature in a 15-foot cone centered on the creature you hit must make a DC 15 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking {@damage 1d8} lightning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

item.name: Electrifying calibrator
entries: As an action, you can apply this calibrator to one {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} or pair of handwraps within 5 feet, granting it a +1 bonus to damage rolls for 1 minute. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Additionally, for the duration, the weapon gains the shocking 13 property. If it already has the shocking property, its shocking number increases by 1, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Electrifying cartridge
entries: An electrifying cartridge is a specialized {@item slug cartridge|sw5e-phb} for use with {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons that deal kinetic damage. When you hit with a shot with the loaded weapon, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d4} lightning damage and becomes {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}.

item.name: Electrifying collimator

This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Additionally, for the duration, the weapon gains the shocking 13 property. If it already has the shocking property, its shocking number increases by 1, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Electrifying dart
entries: This {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} ammunition deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage on a hit. Also on a hit, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking {@damage 1d4} lightning damage on a failed save.
Additionally, on a failed save, a creature is {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} for 1 minute. At the end of an affected creature's turn, it can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Fighter Defensive Augment
entries: When you use your Second Wind feature, you also gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} you regain.

item.name: Fighter Offensive Augment
entries: You learn an additional {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, and you gain one additional superiority die.

item.name: Finesse Oscillator
entries: This weapon gains {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

item.name: Flashlight Attachment
entries: You affix a targeted light to this weapon. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can toggle the light on or off. While on, this weapon sheds bright light in a 60-foot cone.

item.name: Flashlight Guard
entries: You affix a targeted light to this weapon. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can toggle the light on or off. While on, this weapon sheds bright light in a 60-foot cone.

item.name: Flashy
entries: The first time you hit a creature with a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} from this weapon each round, the creature takes an additional {@damage 1d4} damage from the attack.
{@i Flashy is an SSK heavy pistol owned by the mercenary Corso Riggs during the Galactic Cold War.}

item.name: Flechette cannon
entries: The flechette cannon does not make {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. Rather than traditional {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, the flechette cannon uses specialized projector tanks, which, when fired, spray an area with the contents of the tank. Projector tanks require your target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the tank's effects. It can have different ammunition types loaded simultaneously, and you can choose which ammunition you're using as you fire it (no action required). If you don't meet the flechette cannon's strength requirement, creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you lack proficiency in the flechette cannon, you must roll the damage dice twice and take the lesser total.

item.name: Flechette clip, fragmentation
entries: When triggered, this {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} ammunition fires a volley of kinetic flechette rounds in a short line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a long line 45 feet long and 5 feet wide. A single flechette clip holds enough ammunition for three attacks in a short line or one attack in a long line. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 1d10} kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. If you lack proficiency in the {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb}, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on damage rolls with it

item.name: Flechette clip, ion
entries: When triggered, this {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} ammunition fires a volley of ion flechette rounds in a short line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a long line 45 feet long and 5 feet wide. A single flechette clip holds enough ammunition for three attacks in a short line or one attack in a long line. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 1d6} ion damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. Any electronics within the blast radius that aren't being worn or carried are disabled until rebooted. If you lack proficiency in the {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb}, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on damage rolls with it

item.name: Flechette clip, plasma
entries: When triggered, this {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} ammunition fires a volley of energy flechette rounds in a short line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a long line 45 feet long and 5 feet wide. A single flechette clip holds enough ammunition for three attacks in a short line or one attack in a long line. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 1d10} energy damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. If you lack proficiency in the {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb}, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on damage rolls with it

item.name: Flechette mag, fragmentation
entries: When triggered, this {@item flechette cannon|sw5e-wh} ammunition fires a volley of kinetic flechette rounds in a short line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a long line 45 feet long and 5 feet wide. A single flechette mag holds enough ammunition for three attacks in a short line or one attack in a long line. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 2d10} kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: Flechette mag, ion

A single flechette mag holds enough ammunition for three attacks in a short line or one attack in a long line. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} ion damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. Any electronics within the blast radius that aren't being worn or carried are disabled until rebooted.

item.name: Flux Collimator (Average)
entries: As an action, you can apply this collimator to one {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} within 5 feet, granting it a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Additionally, if the weapon is not enhanced, it becomes enhanced for the duration.

item.name: Focus generator
entries: A focus generator is a handheld object used to help forcecasters learn to focus on their powers.

item.name: Focused Amplifier
entries: This item gains the focused property.

item.name: Focused Conductor
entries: This item gains the focused property.

item.name: Focusing Scope
entries: The simple scope allows you to use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to take aim at a target you can see. The next attack you make before the end of your next turn does not suffer {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} due to being made at long range.

item.name: Forged Ferricite Ascendancy Channel
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-level or higher that deals damage, you can increase the damage by two and a half times (rounded down) the number of force points spent.

item.name: Forged Ferricite Dueling Channel
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-level or higher that deals damage, you can increase the damage by the number of force points spent.

item.name: Forged Ferricite Fighting Channel
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-level or higher that deals damage, you can increase the damage by half (rounded down) the number of force points spent.

item.name: Forged Ferricite Mastery Channel
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-level or higher that deals damage, you can increase the damage by one and a half times (rounded down) the number of force points spent.

item.name: Forged Ferricite Supremacy Channel
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-level or higher that deals damage, you can increase the damage by twice the number of force points spent.

item.name: Fortitude Enhancer Mk I
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.
{@b Side Effect:} When you fail a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you treat the damage as if the source had rolled the maximum.

item.name: Fortitude Enhancer Mk II
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.
{@b Side Effect:} When you fail a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you treat the damage as if the source had rolled the maximum.

item.name: Fortitude Enhancer Mk III
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.
{@b Side Effect:} When you fail a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you treat the damage as if the source had rolled the maximum.

item.name: Fortitude Protocol Mk I
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

item.name: Fortitude Protocol Mk II
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

item.name: Fortitude Protocol Mk III
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

item.name: Four-Armed Combatant
entries: You install two additional arms which you can use independently of one another. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms your are benefiting from (no action required).
While you have at least 3 arms free, you have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

item.name: GNS Strength Enhancer
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score becomes 25. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than 25, it has no effect on you.

{@i This large belt greatly increases a users physical power with an array of repulsorfield microgenerators and a pair of reactive-lift actuators that increase raw force and lift-capacity without any loss of speed or fine motor skills.}

item.name: Gas cartridge
entries: A gas cartridge is a specialized {@item slug cartridge|sw5e-phb} for use with {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons that deal kinetic damage. When you hit with a shot with the loaded weapon, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d6} {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage and is {@condition poisoned|sw5e-phb} until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition poisoned|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Gauntlet Armoring
entries: This armor gains the gauntleted ({@dice 1d4}) property. If it already has the gauntleted property, the gauntleted damage increases by one step (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, or from {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}).

item.name: Gauntlet Armoring Mk II
entries: This armor gains the gauntleted ({@dice 1d6}) property. If it already has the gauntleted property, the gauntleted damage increases by two steps (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d8}).

item.name: Gauntlet Armoring Mk III
entries: This armor gains the gauntleted ({@dice 1d8}) property. If it already has the gauntleted property, the gauntleted damage increases to {@dice d8}.

item.name: Gauntlets of the Warrior
entries: This item can hold a number of charges equal to half your guardian level (rounded up). When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, this item regains all missing charges. When you would use your Force-Empowered Strikes feature, you can expend charges instead of force points.

When you reach 5th level in guardian, when you roll a damage die for your Force-Empowered Strikes or Improved Force-Empowered Strikes feature, if you roll less than your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice), you can use the chosen modifier instead of the result on the die.

When you reach 11th level in guardian, the radius of your Guardian Auras increases by 10 feet. Additionally, when you use your Cause Harm or Lend Aid feature, you can add both your Wisdom and Charisma modifier, instead of just one.

item.name: Goggles of the Tinkerer
entries: This item can hold a number of charges equal to half your engineer level (rounded up). When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, this item regains all missing charges. Once per turn, when you use a Potent Aptitude feature, you can spend 1 {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} to roll the Potent Aptitude dice twice and add them together.
When you reach 5th level in engineer, you become a valid target of your Potent Aptitude feature. Additionally, you gain 1 additional modification slot.

When you reach 11th level in engineer, you can add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, rounded down, to any {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with tools you make that doesn't already include your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. Additionally, you gain 1 additional modification slot (2).

When you reach 17th level in engineer, when use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to grant a Potent Aptitude die, you can grant a {@dice d4} instead of expending a use of your Potent Aptitude. Additionally, you gain 1 additional modification slot (3).

item.name: Grappling Harpoon
entries: This armor gains an integrated {@item grappling harpoon|sw5e-wh} set into your gauntlet. With this harpoon, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the harpoon. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the harpoon. Removing the harpoon requires a DC 15 Strength check. While the harpoon is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While the harpoon is deployed, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is larger than you. A creature or object your size or smaller is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the harpoon as an action.

Additionally, on a failed save, a creature becomes {@condition frightened|sw5e-phb} of you for 1 minute. At the start of an affected creature's turn, it can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Grenade, stun
entries: Grenades can be set to detonate on impact or with a timer that causes them to explode on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} count 20 (losing all {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} ties). As an action, you can prime and throw a grenade at a point you can see within 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature is {@condition stunned|sw5e-phb} until the end of their next turn.

Additionally, on a failed save, a creature is {@condition unconscious|sw5e-phb} for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until someone uses an action to shake or slap the creature awake. At the end of an affected creature's turn, it can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Guard Amplifier (Adept)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +3 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Guard Amplifier (Apprentice)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Guard Amplifier (Journeyman)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +2 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Guard Amplifier (Novice)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to melee force attacks and a -1 penalty to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Guard Rangefinder (Adept)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +3 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Guard Rangefinder (Apprentice)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Guard Rangefinder (Journeyman)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +2 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Guard Rangefinder (Novice)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to ranged force attacks and a -1 penalty to melee force attacks.

item.name: Guardian Defensive Augment
entries: You learn an additional Guardian Aura option, and the radius of your Guardian Auras increases by 5 feet.

item.name: Guardian Offensive Augment
entries: The damage die for your Focused Strike die and Improved Force-Empowered Strikes features increases by one step (from {@dice d8} to {@dice d10}, or {@dice d10} to {@dice d12}).

item.name: Handwraps (Basic)
entries: While wearing these handwraps, you have a +1 bonus to damage rolls made with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.

item.name: Handwraps (Champion)
entries: While wearing these handwraps, you have a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and deal an additional {@damage 1d10} damage with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.

item.name: Handwraps (Exceptional)
entries: While wearing these handwraps, you have a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and deal an additional {@damage 1d8} damage with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.

item.name: Handwraps (Fine)
entries: While wearing these handwraps, you have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.

item.name: Handwraps (Improved)
entries: While wearing these handwraps, you have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.

item.name: Handwraps (Superior)
entries: While wearing these handwraps, you have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.

item.name: Handwraps Chassis (Advanced)
entries: These modifiable handwraps chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} modifications, as well as one augment slot. They can house modifications of advanced rarity or lower.

item.name: Handwraps Chassis (Artifact)
entries: These modifiable handwraps chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} modifications, as well as two augment slots. They can house modifications of artifact rarity or lower.

item.name: Handwraps Chassis (Legendary)
entries: These modifiable handwraps chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} modifications, as well as two augment slots. They can house modifications of legendary rarity or lower.

item.name: Handwraps Chassis (Premium)
entries: These modifiable handwraps chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} modifications. They can house modifications of premium rarity or lower.

item.name: Handwraps Chassis (Prototype)
entries: These modifiable handwraps chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} modifications, as well as one augment slot. They can house modifications of prototype rarity or lower.

item.name: Handwraps Chassis (Standard)
entries: These modifiable handwraps chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} modifications. They can house modifications of standard rarity.

item.name: Hardy Torso Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces your torso.

Your Constitution score becomes 13. If your Constitution score is already equal to or greater than 13, it has no effect on you. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item poison|sw5e-phb}.

{@b Side Effect:} When you roll a 1 a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to avoid {@condition exhaustion|sw5e-phb}, you suffer 2 levels of {@condition exhaustion|sw5e-phb}, instead of just 1.
{@i For the wary traveler who is desperately afraid of poison.}

item.name: Harpoon Reel Attachment
entries: You install a secondary firemode that launches a harpoon attached to a tightly coiled cord. With this harpoon, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the harpoon. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the harpoon. Removing the harpoon requires a DC 15 Strength check. While the harpoon is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While connected in this manner, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is your size or larger. A creature or object smaller than you is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the harpoon as an action.

item.name: Harpoon Reel Guard
entries: You install a secondary firemode that launches a harpoon attached to a tightly coiled cord. With this harpoon, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the harpoon. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the harpoon. Removing the harpoon requires a DC 15 Strength check. While the harpoon is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While connected in this manner, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is your size or larger. A creature or object smaller than you is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the harpoon as an action.

item.name: Hawkeye Ocular Package
entries: This augmentation replaces your eyes.

You can activate or deactivate this augmentation as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. While this augmentation is active, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight beyond 30 feet. In conditions of clear visibility, you can make out details of even extremely distant creatures and objects as small as 2 feet across.

{@b Side Effect:} While this augmentation is active, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks within 30 feet that rely on sight.
{@i This eye replacement features integrated macrobinoculars, granting improved ability to see further away.}

item.name: Heavy Cell
entries: This weapon gains the heavy property.

item.name: Heavy Oscillator
entries: This weapon gains the heavy property.

item.name: Heavy Suit
entries: You enhance this armor, making it difficult to move. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can anchor or deanchor your feet to the ground. While anchored, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 0, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength checks and Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

item.name: Helisaber Attachment
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate the attachment. While active, you have a 30-foot flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and whenever you take damage you must make a {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} check as if concentrating on a power. On a failure, you immediately fall to the ground.

item.name: Hewey
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this enhanced weapon.

This weapon has 6 charges and regains {@dice 1d6} charges when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Once per turn when you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} with this weapon, you can expend a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} to have the weapon deal an additional {@damage 1d8} kinetic damage.
{@i Hewey is an N-30 battle blade owned by the mercenary Corso Riggs during the Galactic Cold War.}

item.name: Hidden Compartment {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}
entries: This implant includes a small hidden {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} that is completely shielded and hidden from unenhanced investigation. You cannot use this hidden {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} until it is revealed. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can reveal this weapon and make a single ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with it. You have proficiency with this weapon for this attack. It deals {@damage 1d4} energy damage on a hit, has a range of 20/60, and the light and reload 4 properties.

{@b Side Effect:} Reloading this weapon takes longer than usual. You can reload and re-{@optfeature Conceal|sw5e-phb|conceal} this weapon over one hour, which can be done during a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}. This hidden compartment can only fit the specific {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with which it is paired.
{@i This augmentation hides a weapon in its wearer's forearm that is almost completely undetectable by modern sensors.}

item.name: High-Grade Cybernetic Arm
entries: This augmentation replaces an arm.

When you hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} using Strength with a weapon wielded by this arm, you gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll. Additionally, when you make a Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check that involves this arm, you gain a +1 bonus to the check.
{@b Side Effect:} You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on melee weapon attacks and {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} using Dexterity that involve this arm.
{@i This arm replacement features enhanced strength.}

item.name: High-Grade Cybernetic Legs
entries: This augmentation replaces both legs.

You gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, you can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet, and your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet.
{@b Side Effect:} Your powerful legs have difficulty moving quietly. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks that rely on moving silently.
{@i This mechanical leg replacement increases speed and jumping height.}

item.name: Hilt {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}
entries: You convert this weapon's hilt into a small {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}. The {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} is a ranged weapon with the range 20/60 and reload 6 properties that you are proficient with, and deals {@damage 1d4} energy damage.

item.name: {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb} (Adept)
entries: This {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} contains a single 5th-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, or multiple powers of 1st-4th level with a combined level no greater than 5. After meditating with the {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} for at least 16 hours, a forcecaster with a Max Power Level of 5th or higher can make a DC 22 {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} check with proficiency based on the alignment of the power(s) stored within. On a success, they learn the contained {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}(s), which does not count against their {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and can not be unlearned except through use of a {@spell remove curse|sw5e-phb} power. On a failure, the power is not learned and the forcecaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Holocrons are information-storage devices used by Force-wielders that contain ancient lessons or valuable information in holographic form.}

item.name: {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb} (Ancient)
entries: This {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} contains a single 9th-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, or multiple powers of 1st-8th level with a combined level no greater than 9. After meditating with the {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} for at least 80 hours, a forcecaster with a Max Power Level of 9th or higher can make a DC 30 {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} check with proficiency based on the alignment of the power(s) stored within. On a success, they learn the contained {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}(s), which does not count against their {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and can not be unlearned except through use of a {@spell remove curse|sw5e-phb} power. On a failure, the power is not learned and the forcecaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Holocrons are information-storage devices used by Force-wielders that contain ancient lessons or valuable information in holographic form.}

item.name: {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb} (Apprentice)
entries: This {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} contains a single 1st-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. After meditating with the {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} for at least 4 hours, a forcecaster with a Max Power Level of 1st or higher can make a DC 14 {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} check with proficiency based on the alignment of the power stored within. On a success, they learn the contained {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which does not count against their {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and can not be unlearned except through use of a {@spell remove curse|sw5e-phb} power. On a failure, the power is not learned and the forcecaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Holocrons are information-storage devices used by Force-wielders that contain ancient lessons or valuable information in holographic form.}

item.name: {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb} (Journeyman)
entries: This {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} contains a single 3rd-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, or multiple powers of 1st-2nd level with a combined level no greater than 3. After meditating with the {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} for at least 8 hours, a forcecaster with a Max Power Level of 3rd or higher can make a DC 18 {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} check with proficiency based on the alignment of the power(s) stored within. On a success, they learn the contained {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}(s), which does not count against their {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and can not be unlearned except through use of a {@spell remove curse|sw5e-phb} power. On a failure, the power is not learned and the forcecaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Holocrons are information-storage devices used by Force-wielders that contain ancient lessons or valuable information in holographic form.}

item.name: {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb} (Master)
entries: This {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} contains a single 7th-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, or multiple powers of 1st-6th level with a combined level no greater than 7. After meditating with the {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} for at least 40 hours, a forcecaster with a Max Power Level of 7th or higher can make a DC 26 {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} check with proficiency based on the alignment of the power(s) stored within. On a success, they learn the contained {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}(s), which does not count against their {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and can not be unlearned except through use of a {@spell remove curse|sw5e-phb} power. On a failure, the power is not learned and the forcecaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Holocrons are information-storage devices used by Force-wielders that contain ancient lessons or valuable information in holographic form.}

item.name: {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb} (Novice)
entries: This {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} contains a single at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. After meditating with the {@item Holocron|sw5e-phb|holocron} for at least 2 hours, a forcecaster with a Max Power Level of 1st or higher can make a DC 10 {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} check with proficiency based on the alignment of the power stored within. On a success, they learn the contained {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which does not count against their {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and can not be unlearned except through use of a {@spell remove curse|sw5e-phb} power. On a failure, the power is not learned and the forcecaster can't try again for 24 hours.
{@i Holocrons are information-storage devices used by Force-wielders that contain ancient lessons or valuable information in holographic form.}

item.name: Holster
entries: A holster can be worn on the leg, hip, or back, and can be used to store a single weapon. You can draw a weapon stored in a holster without using an action. Once you've done so, you can't do so again until you store a weapon in the holster as an action.

item.name: Horizontal Exojets
entries: Whenever you take the {@action Dodge|sw5e-phb} or {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} actions, your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet until the end of your turn.

item.name: Humanoid Replicant
entries: Your droid gains an exterior layer that makes it indistinguishable from a species of your choice of the same size. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on checks made to {@optfeature Conceal|sw5e-phb|conceal} your nature, and scanners of standard rarity or lower automatically fail to determine that you are a droid.

item.name: Hydraulic Equalizer
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s strength number is reduced by one step (from 21 to 19, 19 to 17, 17 to 15, 15 to 13, or 13 to 11). If the strength number is 11, this modification removes the strength property from it entirely.

item.name: Hydraulic Equalizer Mk II
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s strength number is reduced by two steps (from 21 to 17, 19 to 15, 17 to 13, or 15 to 11). If the strength number is 13 or lower, this modification removes the strength property from it entirely.

item.name: Hydraulic Equalizer Mk III
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s strength number is reduced by three steps (from 21 to 15, 19 to 13, or 17 to 11). If the strength number is 15 or lower, this modification removes the strength property from it entirely.

item.name: Hydraulic Equalizer Mk IV
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s strength number is reduced by four steps (from 21 to 13 or 19 to 11). If the strength number is 17 or lower, this modification removes the strength property from it entirely.

item.name: Hydraulic Equalizer Mk V
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}'s strength number is reduced by five steps (from 21 to 11). If the strength number is 19 or lower, this modification removes the strength property from it entirely.

item.name: Hydraulic Equalizer Mk VI
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} loses the strength property.

item.name: Impermeable Armoring
entries: This armor gains the impermeable property.

item.name: Impermeable Inlay (Basic)
entries: This clothing gains the impermeable 2 armor property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable armor property, its impermeable number increases by 2, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Inlay (Champion)
entries: This clothing gains the impermeable 9 armor property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable armor property, its impermeable number increases to 9.

item.name: Impermeable Inlay (Exceptional)
entries: This clothing gains the impermeable 8 armor property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable armor property, its impermeable number increases by 8, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Inlay (Fine)
entries: This clothing gains the impermeable 3 armor property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable armor property, its impermeable number increases by 3, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Inlay (Improved)
entries: This clothing gains the impermeable 5 armor property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable armor property, its impermeable number increases by 5, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Inlay (Superior)
entries: This clothing gains the impermeable 6 armor property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable armor property, its impermeable number increases by 6, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Overlay Mk I
entries: This armor gains the impermeable 2 property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable property, its impermeable number increases by 2, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Overlay Mk II
entries: This armor gains the impermeable 3 property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable property, its impermeable number increases by 3, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Overlay Mk III
entries: This armor gains the impermeable 5 property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable property, its impermeable number increases by 5, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Overlay Mk IV
entries: This armor gains the impermeable 6 property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable property, its impermeable number increases by 6, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Overlay Mk V
entries: This armor gains the impermeable 8 property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable property, its impermeable number increases by 8, to a maximum of 9.

item.name: Impermeable Overlay Mk VI
entries: This armor gains the impermeable 9 property (suits chosen by the GM). If it already has the impermeable property, its impermeable number increases to 9.

item.name: Incendiary cell
entries: An incendiary cell is a specialized {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} for use with {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons that deal acid, energy, fire, ion, or sonic damage. The loaded weapon deals fire damage instead of its normal damage type, and when you hit with a shot it sets the ground beneath it in a 5-foot square ablaze for 1 minute. When a creature enters the fire or starts its turn there it must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d8} fire damage or half as much on a successful one. A construct makes this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

item.name: Inconspicuous Shielding
entries: {@i {@b Prerequiste:} {@item Shield|sw5e-phb}}
This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} loses the obtrusive property.

item.name: Increasing Cycler (Adept)
entries: This item gains the increasing 40 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 40, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Cycler (Ancient)
entries: This item gains the increasing 60 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases to 60.

item.name: Increasing Cycler (Apprentice)
entries: This item gains the increasing 20 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 20, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Cycler (Journeyman)
entries: This item gains the increasing 30 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 30, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Cycler (Master)
entries: This item gains the increasing 50 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 50, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Cycler (Novice)
entries: This item gains the increasing 10 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 10, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Motherboard Mk I
entries: This item gains the increasing 10 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 10, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Motherboard Mk II
entries: This item gains the increasing 20 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 20, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Motherboard Mk III
entries: This item gains the increasing 30 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 30, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Motherboard Mk IV
entries: This item gains the increasing 40 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 40, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Motherboard Mk V
entries: This item gains the increasing 50 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases by 50, to a maximum of 60.

item.name: Increasing Motherboard Mk VI
entries: This item gains the increasing 60 property. If it already has the increasing property, its increasing number increases to 60.

item.name: Indomitable Fortress Package
entries: Your Constitution score increases by 1, and your maximum for this score increases by 1. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
{@b Side Effect:} One ability score other than Constitution (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.
{@i This implant drastically increases your endurance.}

item.name: Infiltration Package
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

This implant appears to be a standard cybernetic mechanical arm, but conceals a {@item security kit|sw5e-phb} and a {@item slicer's kit|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, you can also use an action to cast {@spell release|sw5e-phb} at 2nd level without expending tech points or use of a tech focus. Intelligence is your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for this power. Once you've done so, you can't do so again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@b Side Effect:} This hand can no longer wield items that weigh more than 7 lbs.
{@i This fully cybernetic hand replacement contains a hidden array of infiltration tools optimized for defeating a wide variety of security barriers.}

item.name: Inflating Amplifier (Adequate)
entries: This item gains the inflating 10 property. If it already has the inflating property, its inflating number increases by 10, to a maximum of 30.

item.name: Inflating Amplifier (Excellent)
entries: This item gains the inflating 20 property. If it already has the inflating property, its inflating number increases by 20, to a maximum of 30.

item.name: Inflating Amplifier (Leading)
entries: This item gains the inflating 15 property. If it already has the inflating property, its inflating number increases by 15, to a maximum of 30.

item.name: Inflating Amplifier (Outstanding)
