item.name: Inlay Amplifier (Adept)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +3 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Inlay Amplifier (Apprentice)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Inlay Amplifier (Journeyman)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +2 bonus to melee force attacks.

item.name: Inlay Amplifier (Novice)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to melee force attacks and a -1 penalty to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Inlay Rangefinder (Adept)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +3 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Inlay Rangefinder (Apprentice)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Inlay Rangefinder (Journeyman)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +2 bonus to ranged force attacks.

item.name: Inlay Rangefinder (Novice)
entries: While using this item as your focus, you gain a +1 bonus to ranged force attacks and a -1 penalty to melee force attacks.

item.name: Inquisitor Saber
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this enhanced weapon.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you cause the {@item lightsaber|sw5e-phb} to rapidly spin. When you do so, you lose the +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the weapon, but you gain a +1 bonus to AC. Additionally, while spinning, you have a 30-foot flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. While flying, if you take damage, you must make a {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} check as if concentrating on a power. On a failure, you immediately fall to the ground.
{@i These lightweapons, favored by the Jedi hunters known as Inquisitors, have the unique ability to rapidly spin, granting its wielder a limited flying ability.}

item.name: Insulated Pattern (Basic)
entries: This clothing gains the insulated 5 armor property. If it already has the insulated armor property, its insulated number increases by 1, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Insulated Pattern (Champion)
entries: This clothing gains the insulated 10 armor property. If it already has the insulated armor property, its insulated number increases to 10.

item.name: Insulated Pattern (Exceptional)
entries: This clothing gains the insulated 9 armor property. If it already has the insulated armor property, its insulated number increases by 5, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Insulated Pattern (Fine)
entries: This clothing gains the insulated 6 armor property. If it already has the insulated armor property, its insulated number increases by 2, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Insulated Pattern (Improved)
entries: This clothing gains the insulated 7 armor property. If it already has the insulated armor property, its insulated number increases by 3, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Insulated Pattern (Superior)
entries: This clothing gains the insulated 8 armor property. If it already has the insulated armor property, its insulated number increases by 4, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Insulated Reinforcement (Basic)
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the insulated 5 property. If it already has the insulated property, its insulated number increases by 1, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Insulated Reinforcement (Champion)
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the insulated 10 property. If it already has the insulated property, its insulated number increases to 10.

item.name: Insulated Reinforcement (Exceptional)
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the insulated 9 property. If it already has the insulated property, its insulated number increases by 5, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Insulated Reinforcement (Fine)
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the insulated 6 property. If it already has the insulated property, its insulated number increases by 2, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Insulated Reinforcement (Improved)
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the insulated 7 property. If it already has the insulated property, its insulated number increases by 3, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Insulated Reinforcement (Superior)
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the insulated 8 property. If it already has the insulated property, its insulated number increases by 4, to a maximum of 10.

item.name: Integrated Jetboosters Mk I
entries: This armor has a {@item jetpack|sw5e-phb} built in. Activating or deactivating the {@item jetpack|sw5e-phb} requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet. The {@item jetpack|sw5e-phb} last for 1 minute per {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 10 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Integrated Subdermal Armor
entries: When you aren't wearing armor, your AC becomes 13 + your Dexterity modifier.
{@b Side Effect:} Each time you take damage while you aren't wearing armor, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} decreases by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
{@i This implant reinforces your skin with an ablative woven alloy, making you difficult to damage.}

item.name: Integrated Subdermal Armor Mk II
entries: When you aren't wearing armor, your AC becomes 14 + your Dexterity modifier.
{@b Side Effect:} Each time you take damage while you aren't wearing armor, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} decreases by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
{@i This implant reinforces your skin with a high-strength cortosis reinforcement, making you very difficult to damage.}

item.name: Intelligence Augment (Basic)
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 1. One ability score other than Intelligence (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.

item.name: Intelligence Augment (Champion)
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your maximum for this score increases by 2.

item.name: Intelligence Augment (Exceptional)
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 2, and your maximum for this score increases by 1.

item.name: Intelligence Augment (Fine)
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

item.name: Intelligence Augment (Improved)
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 1, and your maximum for this score increases by 1. One ability score other than Intelligence (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.

item.name: Intelligence Augment (Superior)
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 1, and your maximum for this score increases by 1.

item.name: Intelligence Enhancement (Basic)
entries: Your Intelligence score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
{@b Side Effect:} One ability score other than Intelligence (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.

item.name: Intelligence Stim (Basic)
entries: As an action, you can administer this stimpac to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this stimpac, the target's Intelligence score increases by 2, to a maximum of 20. This effect lasts for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from only one stimpac at a time.

item.name: Intelligence Stim (Champion)
entries: As an action, you can administer this stimpac to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this stimpac, the target's Intelligence score increases by 10, and its maximum for this score increases by 10. This effect lasts for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from only one stimpac at a time.

item.name: Intelligence Stim (Exceptional)
entries: As an action, you can administer this stimpac to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this stimpac, the target's Intelligence score increases by 8, and its maximum for this score increases by 8. This effect lasts for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from only one stimpac at a time.

item.name: Intelligence Stim (Fine)
entries: As an action, you can administer this stimpac to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this stimpac, the target's Intelligence score increases by 2, and its maximum for this score increases by 2. This effect lasts for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from only one stimpac at a time.

item.name: Intelligence Stim (Improved)
entries: As an action, you can administer this stimpac to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this stimpac, the target's Intelligence score increases by 4, and its maximum for this score increases by 4. This effect lasts for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from only one stimpac at a time.

item.name: Intelligence Stim (Superior)
entries: As an action, you can administer this stimpac to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this stimpac, the target's Intelligence score increases by 6, and its maximum for this score increases by 6. This effect lasts for 1 hour. A creature can benefit from only one stimpac at a time.

item.name: Intelligence Weave (Basic)
entries: Your level of proficiency in Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} increases by one step (to trained, from trained to proficient, from proficient to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to mastery, from mastery to high mastery, or from high mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: Intelligence Weave (Exceptional)
entries: Your level of proficiency in Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} increases by three steps (to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from trained to mastery, from proficient to high mastery, or from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to grand mastery).

item.name: Intelligence Weave (Improved)
entries: Your level of proficiency in Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} increases by two steps (to proficient, from trained to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from proficient to mastery, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to high mastery, or from mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: Interface Protocol
entries: You become a valid target for the {@spell tracker droid interface|sw5e-phb} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

item.name: Interfaced Assistance Protocol
entries: While you are interfaced via the {@spell tracker droid interface|sw5e-phb} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, whenever your handler has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} granted by you taking the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action, they can reroll one of the dice once.

item.name: Interfaced Crafting Protocol
entries: While you are interfaced via the {@spell tracker droid interface|sw5e-phb} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, whenever your handler makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} using tools with which the you are also proficient, they have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check. If they already have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, they can instead reroll one of the dice once.

item.name: Interfaced Distraction Protocol
entries: While you are interfaced via the {@spell tracker droid interface|sw5e-phb} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, when you are within 5 feet of a target, your handler does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} when moving out of that creature's reach.

item.name: Interfaced Healing Protocol
entries: While you are interfaced via the {@spell tracker droid interface|sw5e-phb} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, when your handler restores {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature that is within 5 feet of you, they can roll the dice twice and take either total.

item.name: Interfaced Tracking Protocol
entries: While you are interfaced via the {@spell tracker droid interface|sw5e-phb} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, when your handler makes a Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check to track a target, and you are also tracking that target, your handler gains {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check. If they already have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, they can instead reroll one of the dice once.

item.name: Interlocking Shielding
entries: {@i {@b Prerequiste:} {@item Shield|sw5e-phb}}
This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the interlocking 1 property. If it already has the interlocking property, its interlocking number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Interlocking Shielding Mk II
entries: {@i {@b Prerequiste:} {@item Shield|sw5e-phb}}
This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the interlocking 2 property. If it already has the interlocking property, its interlocking number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Interlocking Shielding Mk III
entries: {@i {@b Prerequiste:} {@item Shield|sw5e-phb}}
This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the interlocking 3 property. If it already has the interlocking property, its interlocking number increases to 3.

item.name: Intuitive Facial Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces your face.

Your Intelligence score becomes 13. If your Intelligence score is already equal to or greater than 13, it has no effect on you. Additionally, you can add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded down) to any Intelligence check you make that doesn't already include your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

{@b Side Effect:} When you roll a 1 an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the implant stutters, causing any {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} in which you are proficient you make before the start of your next turn to not include your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.
{@i This facial prosthetic includes a solid state drive, allowing for quick recall.}

item.name: {@feat Investigator|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Basic)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Investigation} increases by one step (to trained, from trained to proficient, from proficient to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to mastery, from mastery to high mastery, or from high mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Investigator|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Choice)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Investigation} increases by four steps (to mastery, from trained to high mastery, or from proficient to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Investigator|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Elite)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Investigation} increases by five steps (to high mastery or from trained to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Investigator|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Exquisite)
entries: You gain grand mastery in {@skill Investigation}.

item.name: {@feat Investigator|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Favored)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Investigation} increases by three steps (to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from trained to mastery, from proficient to high mastery, or from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Investigator|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Fine)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Investigation} increases by two steps (to proficient, from trained to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from proficient to mastery, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to high mastery, or from mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: Ion Amplifying Core
entries: This weapon ignores {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to ion damage.

item.name: Iridonian Grav-lev Arm
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} with this arm deal {@damage 1d4} ion damage, and your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples. Additionally, you deal double damage to energy-based structures with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.

{@b Side Effect:} You can no longer wield weapons with electronic components, such as {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true}, {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon}, or {@filter lightweapons|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}. Additionally, if this hand interacts with a small electronic device, such as a {@item datapad|sw5e-phb} or {@item commlink|sw5e-phb}, it is immediately disabled.

{@i This cybernetic arm replacement increases a user's physical strength and can be overloaded to release a unique field resonance discharge that is particularly effective against containment fields and makes holding on to hydrospanners a breeze.}

item.name: J-19 Bo-Rifle
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this enhanced weapon. Additionally, while it is in staff mode, the save DC for its shocking property increases to 14.
{@i This more recent and less artfully designed model of bo-rifle comes with a bayonet attached to the top edge.}

item.name: Jedi Knight's Robe
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to AC while you wear this robe.
{@i Members of the Order typically wear plain or unassuming garments, but this variant offers the additional protection needed by Jedi influencing important events.}

item.name: Jedi Master's Robe
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to AC while you wear this robe.
{@i Members of the Order typically wear plain or unassuming garments, but Jedi Masters also know the importance of adequate protection when great challenges must be surmounted.}

item.name: Jedi Padawan's Robe
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you wear this robe.
{@i Members of the Jedi Order typically wear plain or unassuming garments, offering only a minor boost to defenses.}

item.name: Jensaarai Armor
entries: While wearing this armor, you are considered proficient regardless of whether or not you have proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}. Additionally, it grants a +1 bonus to AC.

{@b {@i Jensaarai Regalia.}} While wearing and attuned to this armor and {@item Jensaarai Cloak|sw5e-wh}, you are adapted to both hot and cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide. Additionally, this armor now grants a +2 bonus to AC, instead of +1. While wearing and attuned to this armor, {@item Jensaarai Cloak|sw5e-wh}, and {@item Jensaarai Headgear|sw5e-wh}, this armor now grants a +3 bonus to AC, instead of +2.
{@i At the height of their training, Jensaarai craft and bond with their own armor. While each set of armor is unique to its bearer, they share similar traits.}

item.name: Jensaarai Cloak
entries: While wearing this cloak with its hood up, you can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding. Pulling the hood up or down requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

{@b {@i Jensaarai Regalia.}} While wearing and attuned to this cloak and {@item Jensaarai Armor|sw5e-wh}, while its hood is up, Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to see you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide. While wearing and attuned to this cloak, Jensaraai Armor, and {@item Jensaarai Headgear|sw5e-wh}, when you make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to an avoid an effect that would deal cold, energy, fire, force, or kinetic damage, you can add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) to the roll if it doesn't already include that modifier.
{@i Most Jensaari wear a gray cloak that subtly adapts to their surroundings.}

item.name: Jensaarai Headgear
entries: While you are wearing this headgear, kinetic and energy damage that you take from unenhanced weapons is reduced by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

{@b {@i Jensaarai Regalia.}} While wearing and attuned to this armor and {@item Jensaarai Armor|sw5e-wh}, this headgear no longer count towards your maximum attunement. While wearing and attuned to this headgear, {@item Jensaarai Armor|sw5e-wh}, and {@item Jensaarai Cloak|sw5e-wh}, fire, cold, and force damage you take is reduced by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.
{@i Most Jensaarai craft a mask or helmet bearing the visage of an animal that best personifies their desires or goals.}

item.name: {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb} (Champion)
entries: Jetpacks are personal aerial transportation devices that allow the operator to fly into and through the air with great mobility. Activating or deactivating the {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 80 feet. The {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} last for 1 minute per {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 20 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb} (Exceptional)
entries: Jetpacks are personal aerial transportation devices that allow the operator to fly into and through the air with great mobility. Activating or deactivating the {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 70 feet. The {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} last for 1 minute per {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 18 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb} (Fine)
entries: Jetpacks are personal aerial transportation devices that allow the operator to fly into and through the air with great mobility. Activating or deactivating the {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 40 feet. The {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} last for 1 minute per {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 12 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: Jetpacks are personal aerial transportation devices that allow the operator to fly into and through the air with great mobility. Activating or deactivating the {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 50 feet. The {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} last for 1 minute per {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 14 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb} (Superior)
entries: Jetpacks are personal aerial transportation devices that allow the operator to fly into and through the air with great mobility. Activating or deactivating the {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 60 feet. The {@item Jetpack|sw5e-phb|jetpack} last for 1 minute per {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 16 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Karrak
entries: A powerful painkiller, karrak allows creatures to continue through the most grievous injuries. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d3} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and at the start of each of the creature's turns it gains {@dice 2d3} temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 10 minutes, during which they must roll a {@dice d3} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and for the duration their current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by {@dice 2d3}. If this would reduce your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} below 1, it instead becomes 1. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Karrak (Fine)
entries: A powerful painkiller, karrak allows creatures to continue through the most grievous injuries. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d4} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and at the start of each of the creature's turns it gains {@dice 2d4} temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 1 hour, during which they must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and for the duration their current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by {@dice 2d4}. If this would reduce your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} below 1, it instead becomes 1. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Karrak (High Quality)
entries: A powerful painkiller, karrak allows creatures to continue through the most grievous injuries. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next 10 minutes, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d8} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and at the start of each of the creature's turns it gains {@dice 2d8} temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 4 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d8} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and for the duration their current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by {@dice 2d8}. If this would reduce your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} below 1, it instead becomes 1. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 20 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Karrak (Potent)
entries: A powerful painkiller, karrak allows creatures to continue through the most grievous injuries. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next hour, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d10} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and at the start of each of the creature's turns it gains {@dice 2d10} temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 4 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d10} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and for the duration their current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by {@dice 2d10}. If this would reduce your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} below 1, it instead becomes 1. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 22 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Karrak (Pure)
entries: A powerful painkiller, karrak allows creatures to continue through the most grievous injuries. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next hour, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d12} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and at the start of each of the creature's turns it gains {@dice 2d12} temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 24 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 8 hours, during which they must roll a {@dice d12} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and for the duration their current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by {@dice 2d12}. If this would reduce your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} below 1, it instead becomes 1. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 24 Constitution throw to resist addiction.

item.name: Karrak (Uncut)
entries: A powerful painkiller, karrak allows creatures to continue through the most grievous injuries. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next 10 minutes, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d6} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and at the start of each of the creature's turns it gains {@dice 2d6} temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 1 hour, during which they must roll a {@dice d6} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and for the duration their current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by {@dice 2d6}. If this would reduce your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} below 1, it instead becomes 1. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 18 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Keen Beam
entries: This weapon gains the keen 1 property. If it already has the keen property, its keen number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Keen Beam (Deadly)
entries: This weapon gains the keen 2 property. If it already has the keen property, its keen number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Keen Beam (Devastating)
entries: This weapon gains the keen 3 property. If it already has the keen property, its keen number increases to 3.

item.name: Keen Core
entries: This weapon gains the keen 1 property. If it already has the keen property, its keen number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Keen Core (Deadly)
entries: This weapon gains the keen 2 property. If it already has the keen property, its keen number increases by 2, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Keen Core (Devastating)
entries: This weapon gains the keen 3 property. If it already has the keen property, its keen number increases to 3.

item.name: Keen Oscillator
entries: This weapon gains the keen 1 property. If it already has the keen property, its keen number increases by 1, to a maximum of 3.

item.name: Keen Oscillator (Deadly)

item.name: Keen Oscillator (Devastating)

item.name: Lambent Shielding
entries: This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the lambent property.

item.name: Leg Reinforcements
entries: When you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier.

item.name: Light Cell
entries: This weapon gains the light property.

item.name: Light Core
entries: This weapon gains the light property.

item.name: Light Oscillator
entries: This weapon gains the light property.

item.name: Lightweapon Chassis (Advanced)
entries: This modifiable {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} modifications, as well as one augment slot. It can house modifications of advanced rarity or lower.

item.name: Lightweapon Chassis (Artifact)
entries: This modifiable {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} modifications, as well as two augment slots. It can house modifications of artifact rarity or lower.

item.name: Lightweapon Chassis (Legendary)
entries: This modifiable {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} modifications, as well as two augment slots. It can house modifications of legendary rarity or lower.

item.name: Lightweapon Chassis (Premium)
entries: This modifiable {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} modifications. It can house modifications of premium rarity or lower.

item.name: Lightweapon Chassis (Prototype)
entries: This modifiable {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} modifications, as well as one augment slot. It can house modifications of prototype rarity or lower.

item.name: Lightweapon Chassis (Standard)
entries: This modifiable {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} chassis comes with vacant modification slots for {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} modifications. It can house modifications of standard rarity.

item.name: Lightweight Reinforcement
entries: This armor or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the lightweight property.

item.name: Lightweight Stabilizer Frame
entries: This weapon loses the two-handed property.

item.name: Lightweight Weave
entries: This clothing gains the lightweight armor property.

item.name: {@feat Loremaster|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Basic)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Lore} increases by one step (to trained, from trained to proficient, from proficient to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to mastery, from mastery to high mastery, or from high mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Loremaster|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Choice)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Lore} increases by four steps (to mastery, from trained to high mastery, or from proficient to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Loremaster|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Elite)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Lore} increases by five steps (to high mastery or from trained to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Loremaster|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Exquisite)
entries: You gain grand mastery in {@skill Lore}.

item.name: {@feat Loremaster|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Favored)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Lore} increases by three steps (to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from trained to mastery, from proficient to high mastery, or from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to grand mastery).

item.name: {@feat Loremaster|sw5e-phb}'s Pattern (Fine)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Lore} increases by two steps (to proficient, from trained to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from proficient to mastery, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to high mastery, or from mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: Machinist's Catalyzer Mk I
entries: As an action, you can administer this catalyzer to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target gains a +1 bonus to its damage and healing rolls with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one catalyzer at a time.

item.name: Machinist's Catalyzer Mk II
entries: As an action, you can administer this catalyzer to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target gains a +1 bonus to its tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}, tech save DC, and damage and healing rolls with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one catalyzer at a time.

item.name: Machinist's Catalyzer Mk III
entries: As an action, you can administer this catalyzer to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target gains a +2 bonus to its tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}, tech save DC, and damage and healing rolls with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one catalyzer at a time.

item.name: Machinist's Catalyzer Mk IV
entries: As an action, you can administer this catalyzer to a creature within 5 feet. When you administer this adrenal, the target gains a +3 bonus to its tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}, tech save DC, and damage and healing rolls with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. This effect lasts for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one catalyzer at a time.

item.name: Mag-lock Boots
entries: While you wear these boots, you can activate or deactivate heir mag-locks as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. While the mag locks are engaged, you move at half {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, can walk on any solid metallic surface, ignore {@quickref difficult terrain||3} caused by metallic debris, and ignore the effects of gravity (or the lack thereof), allowing you to walk up vertical surfaces or even upside-down.
The battery in these boots lasts for a total of 1 hour and recharges at the end of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

item.name: Magnetic Forearm Enhancement
entries: This augmentation replaces a forearm.
Unarmed strikes with this hand have the reach property.

{@b Side Effect:} When you roll a 1 on an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} with this arm, the hand disconnects and falls to the ground. It can be picked up and replaced as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.
{@i This hand replacement creates a magnetic connection between the hand and forearm, emitting a minor hum.}

item.name: Magnetic-Lock Grip
entries: While wielding this weapon, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to disarm or avoid being disarmed.

item.name: Magnetized {@item Shield|sw5e-phb}
entries: This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the magnetic 13 property. If it already has the magnetic property, its magnetic number increases by 1, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Magnetized {@item Shield|sw5e-phb} (Champion)
entries: This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the magnetic 18 property. If it already has the magnetic property, its magnetic number increases to 18.

item.name: Magnetized {@item Shield|sw5e-phb} (Exceptional)
entries: This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the magnetic 17 property. If it already has the magnetic property, its magnetic number increases by 5, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Magnetized {@item Shield|sw5e-phb} (Fine)
entries: This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the magnetic 14 property. If it already has the magnetic property, its magnetic number increases by 2, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Magnetized {@item Shield|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the magnetic 15 property. If it already has the magnetic property, its magnetic number increases by 3, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Magnetized {@item Shield|sw5e-phb} (Superior)
entries: This {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} gains the magnetic 16 property. If it already has the magnetic property, its magnetic number increases by 4, to a maximum of 18.

item.name: Manageability Armoring
entries: This armor loses the bulky property.

item.name: Mandalorian Beskar'gam
entries: This armor comes equipped with 24 slots that can each hold a single item that weighs less than 2 lb. Additionally, it grants a +1 bonus to AC.

{@b {@i Mandalorian Vestments.}} While wearing and attuned to this armor and {@item Mandalorian Helmet|sw5e-wh}, you are able to {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb|survive} and operate in zero gravity space and other dangerous conditions. Additionally, this armor now grants a +2 bonus to AC, instead of +1. While wearing and attuned to this armor, {@item Mandalorian Helmet|sw5e-wh}, and {@item Mandalorian Shuk'orok|sw5e-wh}, this armor now grants a +3 bonus to AC, instead of +2.
{@i This armor is forged from an incredibly rare material known as beskar, a highly durable metal.}

item.name: Mandalorian Helmet
entries: This helmet comes equipped with a {@item headcomm|sw5e-phb} and {@item holorecorder|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, while wearing this helmet, you have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} out to 60 feet.

{@b {@i Mandalorian Vestments.}} While wearing and attuned to this helmet and {@item Mandalorian Beskar'gam|sw5e-wh}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight within 60 feet. While wearing and attuned to this helmet, {@item Mandalorian Beskar'gam|sw5e-wh}, and {@item Mandalorian Shuk'orok|sw5e-wh}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks within 5 feet.
{@i Featuring the iconic T-shaped visor of the Mandalorians, this helmet strikes fear into the hearts of the unwary.}

item.name: Mandalorian Shuk'orok
entries: While wearing these gloves, your Strength score becomes 21. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than 21, it has no effect on you.

{@b {@i Mandalorian Vestments.}} While wearing and attuned to these gloves and {@item Mandalorian Beskar'gam|sw5e-wh}, these gauntlets no longer count towards your maximum attunement. While wearing and attuned to these gloves, {@item Mandalorian Beskar'gam|sw5e-wh}, and {@item Mandalorian Helmet|sw5e-wh}, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage from unenhanced sources.
{@i The final piece of a Mandalorian's armor, these gauntlets grant augmented strength.}

item.name: Manipulator Upgrade
entries: You lose the Undersized special trait.

item.name: Mantle of the Anomic
entries: This item can hold a number of charges equal to half your sentinel level (rounded up). When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, this item regains all missing charges. When you would use a Force-Empowered Self option, you can expend charges instead of force points.
When you reach 5th level in sentinel, you can use two Force-Empowered Self options per hit, instead of only one.
When you reach 11th level in sentinel, you can use each Force-Empowered Self option twice per turn, instead of only once. You can still only use each option once per hit.
When you reach 17th level in sentinel, you can use your Enlightened Evasion feature for any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, instead of just against effects that deal damage.
{@i This visually unremarkable mantle resists effects that would cause it to move or make noise.}

item.name: Maser Core
entries: When a creature tries to reduce the damage of a shot from this weapon with a feature or power, such as monk's Deflect Missiles or the {@spell saber reflect|sw5e-phb} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the reduction roll.

item.name: Matrix Armor
entries: While wearing this suit of armor, any {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} against you becomes a normal hit.
{@i This suit of armor has had its protective durasteel components replaced by equivalents made of matrix, a purple metal used to reinforce starships.}

item.name: Mechanic
entries: As an action, you can activate the repair tools, choosing one of the following options:

items: You can stabilize a droid within 5 feet of you that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, without needing to make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology}) check.
You can restore {@dice 2d4 + 2} {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a droid or construct within 5 feet.

entries: You can use each feature once. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@i This part equips the droid with a series of machine repair tools.}

item.name: Medic
entries: As an action, you can activate the medical kit, choosing one of the following options:

items: You can stabilize a creature within 5 feet of you that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, without needing to make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.
You can restore {@dice 1d4 + 1} {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature within 5 feet.

You can cure a target of one {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} affecting them or to give them {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} for 1 hour.

entries: This medical kit has no effect on droids or constructs. You can use each feature once. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
{@i This part equips the droid with a compact medical kit.}

item.name: Medic's Pattern (Basic)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Medicine} increases by one step (to trained, from trained to proficient, from proficient to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to mastery, from mastery to high mastery, or from high mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: Medic's Pattern (Choice)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Medicine} increases by four steps (to mastery, from trained to high mastery, or from proficient to grand mastery).

item.name: Medic's Pattern (Elite)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Medicine} increases by five steps (to high mastery or from trained to grand mastery).

item.name: Medic's Pattern (Exquisite)
entries: You gain grand mastery in {@skill Medicine}.

item.name: Medic's Pattern (Favored)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Medicine} increases by three steps (to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from trained to mastery, from proficient to high mastery, or from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to grand mastery).

item.name: Medic's Pattern (Fine)
entries: Your level of proficiency in {@skill Medicine} increases by two steps (to proficient, from trained to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from proficient to mastery, from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to high mastery, or from mastery to grand mastery).

item.name: {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb} (Champion)
entries: A {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} is a quick-acting syringe filled with a concentrated dose of kolto. As an action, you can use this {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a beast or humanoid within 5 feet. The creature rolls six dice equal to the size of their Hit Die and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled + their Constitution modifier (minimum of one hit point). If the creature has Hit Dice of different sizes, use whichever Hit Die size they have the most of.

item.name: {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb} (Exceptional)
entries: A {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} is a quick-acting syringe filled with a concentrated dose of kolto. As an action, you can use this {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a beast or humanoid within 5 feet. The creature rolls five dice equal to the size of their Hit Die and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled + their Constitution modifier (minimum of one hit point). If the creature has Hit Dice of different sizes, use whichever Hit Die size they have the most of.

item.name: {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb} (Fine)
entries: A {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} is a quick-acting syringe filled with a concentrated dose of kolto. As an action, you can use this {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a beast or humanoid within 5 feet. The creature rolls two dice equal to the size of their Hit Die and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled + their Constitution modifier (minimum of one hit point). If the creature has Hit Dice of different sizes, use whichever Hit Die size they have the most of.

item.name: {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb} (Improved)
entries: A {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} is a quick-acting syringe filled with a concentrated dose of kolto. As an action, you can use this {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a beast or humanoid within 5 feet. The creature rolls three dice equal to the size of their Hit Die and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled + their Constitution modifier (minimum of one hit point) If the creature has Hit Dice of different sizes, use whichever Hit Die size they have the most of.

item.name: {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb} (Superior)
entries: A {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} is a quick-acting syringe filled with a concentrated dose of kolto. As an action, you can use this {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac} to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a beast or humanoid within 5 feet. The creature rolls four dice equal to the size of their Hit Die and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled + their Constitution modifier (minimum of one hit point). If the creature has Hit Dice of different sizes, use whichever Hit Die size they have the most of.

item.name: MerenData Excelcior
entries: When you deal cold damage to a creature with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} cast through this {@item wristpad|sw5e-phb}, the creature gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of its next turn.

item.name: Microphasic Hypervisor
entries: This augmentation replaces your eyes.
You can activate or deactivate this implant as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. While active, you have {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} to a range of 30 feet.
{@b Side Effect:} While active, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks beyond 30 feet.
{@i This augmentation is a large, boxy eye replacement that covers both eyes with digital optic feeds and high resolution sensors.}

item.name: Mighty {@feat Athlete|sw5e-phb} Package
entries: Your Strength score increases by 1, and your maximum for this score increases by 1. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
{@b Side Effect:} One ability score other than Strength (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.
{@i This implant drastically increases your physical capacities.}

item.name: Mighty Build
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

item.name: Mighty Core
entries: This weapon gains the mighty property.

item.name: {@item Mine, fragmentation|sw5e-phb|Mine, Fragmentation} (Average)
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item remote detonator|sw5e-phb}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which activates at the start of your next turn. When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 16 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 4d10} kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: {@item Mine, fragmentation|sw5e-phb|Mine, Fragmentation} (Deadly)
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item remote detonator|sw5e-phb}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which activates at the start of your next turn. When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 8d10} kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: {@item Mine, fragmentation|sw5e-phb|Mine, Fragmentation} (Devastating)
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item remote detonator|sw5e-phb}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which activates at the start of your next turn. When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 24 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 12d10} kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: {@item Mine, fragmentation|sw5e-phb|Mine, Fragmentation} (Lethal)
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item remote detonator|sw5e-phb}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which activates at the start of your next turn. When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 22 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 10d10} kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: {@item Mine, fragmentation|sw5e-phb|Mine, Fragmentation} (Major)
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item remote detonator|sw5e-phb}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which activates at the start of your next turn. When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 6d10} kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

item.name: Mine, corrosive
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item remote detonator|sw5e-phb}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which arms at the start of your next turn. When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 2d8} acid damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it must make a DC 13 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it dies immediately without making {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}. A disintegrated creature and everything unenhanced it is wearing or carrying are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. A creature destroyed in this way can not be revitalized.

item.name: Mine, cryo

When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} cold damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one.

Additionally, on a failed save, a creature gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level for 1 minute. At the end of an affected creature's turn, it can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Missile, incendiary
entries: This {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} ammunition deals {@damage 1d6} kinetic damage on a hit. Additionally, hit or miss, the missile then explodes, setting the ground beneath it in a 15 foot radius ablaze for 1 minute. When a creature enters the fire or starts its turn there it must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 1d8} fire damage or half as much on a successful one. A construct makes this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

item.name: Missile, ion

item.name: Mummergy
entries: Mummergy is a strong-smelling liquor derived from a plant of the same name. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d3} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Intelligence. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 10 minutes, during which they must roll a {@dice d3} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Intelligence. item.name: Necklace of Determination
entries: This item can hold a number of charges equal to half your monk level (rounded up). When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, this item regains all missing charges. When you would expend a focus point, you can instead expend a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}.
When you reach 5th level in monk, when you use your Slow Fall feature, the amount is increased to ten times your monk level, instead of five.
When you reach 11th level in monk, when you use your Deflect Missiles feature, you can add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier to the roll (your choice, a minimum of +1).
When you reach 17th level in monk, you can add half your Dexterity modifier (rounded down) to your focus save DC and focus attack modifier.
{@i This simple necklace comprised of a series of tiny gray beads hosts a single pale blue crystal that glows faintly.}

item.name: Net (Champion)
entries: A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is {@condition restrained|sw5e-phb} until it is freed. A net has no effect on formless or Huge or larger creatures. A creature can use its action to make a DC 18 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The net has an AC of 15, 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, immunity to all damage not dealt by melee weapons, and {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to damage dealt by unenhanced melee weapons. Destroying the net frees the creature without harming it and immediately ends the net's effects. While a creature is {@condition restrained|sw5e-phb} by a net, you can make no further attacks with it.

item.name: Orbalisk Armor
entries: This armor has no weight and does not affect encumbrance. While wearing it, you are considered proficient regardless of whether or not you have proficiency with {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, and you are resistant to all unenhanced damage.

{@b {@i Cursed.}} You can not remove this armor without first killing the orbalisks. While wearing this armor, whenever you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you must make a DC 15 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. You can choose to fail this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. For each {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you fail, the size of your Hit Die is reduced by one step (from {@dice d12} to {@dice d10}, from {@dice d10} to {@dice d8}, from {@dice d8} to {@dice d6}, from {@dice d6} to {@dice d4}, or from {@dice d4} to {@dice d2}). If you fail a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} while your Hit Die is a {@dice d2}, you die as the orbalisks consume you. Additionally, for each {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you fail, your AC increases by 1. For each {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you succeed, the size of your Hit Die increases by one step (from {@dice d2} to {@dice d4}, from {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, from {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}, from {@dice d8} to {@dice d10}, or from {@dice d10} to {@dice d12}). Additionally, for each {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you succeed, your AC decreases by 1. The size of your Hit Die can not exceed the Hit Dice granted by your class, and your AC can not be increased or reduced more than the number of Hit Die increases or reductions.
{@i This armor is comprised of a series of small parasitic creatures called orbalisks. Over time, orbalisks reproduce until they cover the entirety of their host.}

Once applied, the {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} retains potency for 1 minute before drying.

item.name: Portable Teleporter Mk I
entries: As an action, you can use this teleporter to create a pair of linked portals: one portal appears in a space within 5 feet of you, and the other portal appears in an unoccupied space you can see up to 30 feet away. These portals lasts until the start of your next turn, and they are large enough to accommodate Medium and smaller creatures and objects. Portals take the appearance of an elongated, shimmering {@item Mirror|sw5e-phb|mirror}, and looking through a portal, a creature can see through the linked portal as if looking through a window. A creature or object who passes through a portal immediately appears in a space within 5 feet of the linked portal.

item.name: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|Power Cell} (Average)
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this enhanced {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} is depleted, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|Power Cell} (Deadly)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this enhanced {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} is depleted, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|Power Cell} (Devastating)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and deal an additional {@damage 1d10} damage with this enhanced {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} is depleted, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|Power Cell} (Lethal)
entries: You have a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and deal an additional {@damage 1d8} damage with this enhanced {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} is depleted, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|Power Cell} (Major)
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this enhanced {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}. This bonus is in addition to any bonuses granted by the weapon. Once the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} is depleted, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Power Supply Port
entries: You gain the ability to {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} expended {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells} and {@item power generator|sw5e-wh|power generators} within your reach. You have a charging capacity of 1 hour. You can spend 10 minutes of this charging capacity to replenish an expended {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}, or 1 hour replenishing an expended {@item power generator|sw5e-wh}. Alternatively, you can directly connect to and power a single {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon that uses {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} or {@item power generator|sw5e-wh}. Once per turn, if the powered weapon would be reloaded, it can be done without using an action, instead expending 10 minutes of your charging capacity if it uses {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells} or 1 hour if it uses a {@item power generator|sw5e-wh}. Connecting or disconnecting a weapon takes an action.
If you attempt to replenish an enhanced {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} or {@item power generator|sw5e-wh}, or a specialized {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}, it loses its enhanced or specialized properties.

item.name: Power belt
entries: This belt has slots to hold six {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, and can be connected to directly power a single {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapon that uses {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}. Once per turn, if the powered weapon would be reloaded, it can be done without using an action using any ammunition in the belt. Connecting or disconnecting a weapon takes an action. Replacing an expended {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} takes an action.

item.name: Projector canister, corrosive
entries: When triggered, this {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} ammunition produces a spray of acid in a line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a 15-foot cone. A single fuel canister holds enough fuel for three attacks in a line or a single attack in a cone. Each creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d6} acid damage, and the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't disadvantaged. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it must make a DC 13 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it dies immediately without making {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. If you lack proficiency in the {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb}, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on damage rolls with it

item.name: Projector tank, corrosive
entries: When triggered, this {@item vapor projector|sw5e-wh} ammunition produces a spray of acid in a line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a 15-foot cone. A single fuel tank holds enough fuel for three attacks in a line or a single attack in a cone. Each creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d6} acid damage, and the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't disadvantaged. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it must make a DC 13 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it dies immediately without making {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust.

item.name: Projector tank, cryo
entries: When triggered, this {@item vapor projector|sw5e-wh} ammunition produces a beam of {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} energy in a line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a 15-foot cone. A single fuel tank holds enough fuel for three attacks in a line or a single attack in a cone. Each creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d4} cold damage and gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed}. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, that creature is frozen in {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} for 1 hour.

item.name: Projector tank, incendiary
entries: When triggered, this {@item vapor projector|sw5e-wh} ammunition produces a burst of flame in a line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a 15-foot cone. A single fuel tank holds enough fuel for three attacks in a line or a single attack in a cone. Each creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking {@damage 2d8} fire damage or half as much on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

item.name: {@feat Quick-Fingered|sw5e-phb} Pattern (Favored)

item.name: Raava
entries: Raava is a traditional liquor breed from zsajhira berries. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d3} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Dexterity. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 10 minutes, during which they must roll a {@dice d3} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Dexterity. item.name: {@item Repair kit|sw5e-phb|Repair Kit} Mk II
entries: A {@item repair kit|sw5e-phb} includes the basic tools needed to repair a droid after being damaged in combat. The kit has three uses. As an action, you can expend one use of the kit to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a droid or construct within 5 feet. The creature rolls two dice equal to the size of their Hit Die and regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled + their Constitution modifier (minimum of one hit point). If the creature has Hit Dice of different sizes, use whichever Hit Die size they have the most of.

entries: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher.
{@i Though the knowledge to forge a pair of true} shuk'orok {@i is a closely-guarded Mandalorian secret, the effects of these gloves are desirable enough to spawn numerous imitators.}

item.name: Ring of Adept Force Storing
entries: This ring stores {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 6 levels worth of {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at a time. When found, it contains {@dice 1d7 - 1} levels of stored {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} chosen by the GM.

Any creature can cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st through 6th level into the ring by touching the ring as the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} is cast. The {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} has no effect, other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can't hold the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} determines how much space it uses.

While wearing this ring, you can cast any {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} stored in it. The {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} uses the slot level, force save DC, force attack bonus, and {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} of the original caster, but is otherwise treated as if you cast the {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. The {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.

item.name: {@item Rocket boots|sw5e-phb|Rocket Boots} (Champion)
entries: {@item Rocket boots|sw5e-phb} are a form of rocket propulsion system affixed to a pair of boots instead of being worn on the back like a standard {@item jetpack|sw5e-phb}. Activating or deactivating the boots requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 50 feet. The {@item Rocket boots|sw5e-phb|rocket boots} last for 1 minute and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Rocket launcher
entries: Rather than traditional {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, the rocket launcher fires specialized projectiles in the form of rockets. When firing a rocket at long range, or if you don't meet the rocket launcher's strength requirement, creatures within the radius of the rocket's {@spell Explosion|sw5e-phb|explosion} have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

item.name: Rocket, fragmentation
entries: This {@item rocket launcher|sw5e-wh} ammunition deals {@damage 2d6} kinetic damage on a hit. Additionally, hit or miss, the rocket then explodes. The target and each creature within 15 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking {@damage 2d10} kinetic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

item.name: Rocket, incendiary
entries: This {@item rocket launcher|sw5e-wh} ammunition deals {@damage 2d6} kinetic damage on a hit. Additionally, hit or miss, the rocket then explodes, setting the ground beneath it in a 15 foot radius ablaze for 1 minute. When a creature enters the fire or starts its turn there it must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d8} fire damage or half as much on a successful one. A construct makes this save with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

item.name: Rocket, ion
entries: This {@item rocket launcher|sw5e-wh} ammunition deals {@damage 2d6} kinetic damage on a hit. Additionally, hit or miss, the rocket then explodes. The target and each creature within 15 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking {@damage 2d6} ion damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. Any electronics within the blast radius that aren't being worn or carried are disabled until rebooted.

item.name: Rocketpack
entries: Rocketpacks combine the aerial transportation of a {@item jetpack|sw5e-phb} with the firepower of a {@item rocket launcher|sw5e-wh}. Activating or deactivating the rocketpack's flight capabilities requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet. The {@item jetpack|sw5e-phb} last for 1 minute per {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 5 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb}.

Additionally, your rocketpack comes with an integrated {@item rocket launcher|sw5e-wh} with the Ammunition (range 100/400) and reload 1 properties. Rather than traditional {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, this {@item rocket launcher|sw5e-wh} fires specialized projectiles in the form of rockets. Whenever you would make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can instead fire this {@item rocket launcher|sw5e-wh}. When firing a rocket at long range, creatures within the radius of the rocket's {@spell Explosion|sw5e-phb|explosion} have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Reloading this {@item rocket launcher|sw5e-wh} takes 1 minute.

item.name: Rocketpack (Champion)

entries: When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action and hit a target with a ranged attack with this weapon, you can repeat the attack against another creature up to 15 feet from the target in a direct line from you (no action required). Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

item.name: Scholar Defensive Augment
entries: You learn an additional discovery. When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can change this discovery for a different option available to you.

item.name: Scholar Offensive Augment
entries: You learn an additional {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, and you gain one additional superiority die.

item.name: Scout Defensive Augment
entries: You learn an additional Scout Routine option, and the radius of your Scout Routines increases by 5 feet.

item.name: Scout Offensive Augment
entries: You can apply the additional damage from your Ranger's Quarry feature one additional time per turn.

item.name: Security Spike (Champion)
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit}) check, you can use the spike (no action required) to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check, and then you can reroll both of the dice once. You can wait until after you roll the {@dice d20} before deciding to use the spike, but you must decide before the GM says whether the check succeeds or fails.

item.name: Security Spike (Fine)

You can wait until after you roll the {@dice d20} before deciding to use the spike, but you must decide before the GM says whether the check succeeds or fails.

item.name: Security spike
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit}) check, you can use the spike (no action required) to reroll the check. You must use the new roll. You can wait until after you roll the {@dice d20} before deciding to use the spike, but you must decide before the GM says whether the check succeeds or fails.

item.name: Sentinel Offensive Augment

item.name: Sentry

You can cast it once, without the use of a {@item wristpad|sw5e-phb} and without spending tech points, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. entries: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls with weapons and {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} while you wear this robe.

item.name: Sith Lord's Robe
