{@i Designed for those who relish personal combat, and know that power comes to those who take it, these robes masterfully augment offensive capabilities with no hindrance to movement.}

item.name: Sith Strength Belt
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score becomes 27. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than 27, it has no effect on you.

{@i Worn on the legs, waist and lower back, this belt massively increases a users physical power with a set of heavy durasteel actuators alongside an synaptic monitoring system that reacts to its users motion with optimized power responses.}

item.name: Sith Warrior's Robe
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with weapons and {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} while you wear this robe.

{@b Side Effect:} When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} using a skill you are not proficient in, you must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the result from the total.
{@i This implant includes a library of situational information that it injects directly into your consciousness.}

item.name: Slipstream Kickers

Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

The snare has an AC of 10, 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, and immunity to all damage not dealt by melee weapons. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 14 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Surveillance Implant
entries: This augmentation replaces your face.
This implant includes a {@item headcomm|sw5e-phb} with a scrambler that automatically encodes messages sent to a specified recipient {@item commlink|sw5e-phb} or receiver.

{@b Side Effect:} You can not use portable personal devices used for communication or jamming, such as a {@item commlink|sw5e-phb} or {@item holotrace device|sw5e-phb}, due to interference with this implant.
{@i This augmentation appears as a crescent around one eye paired with two small dots above the eyebrow.}

item.name: {@skill Survival} and Surveillance Implant
entries: This augmentation replaces your eyes and face.

This implant contains several tools for long-term survival and reconnaissance. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate one of the below modes that enable you to use several of these tools at once. Only one mode can be active at a time.

items: {@b Communications Mode:} This communications suite includes a {@item headcomm|sw5e-phb} with a scrambler that automatically encodes messages sent to a specified recipient {@item commlink|sw5e-phb} or receiver. While this mode is active, you cannot be {@condition deafened|sw5e-phb}.
{@b Interceptor Mode:} This is a jamming and electronic warfare suite that includes a {@item comm jammer|sw5e-phb}, a {@item holotrace device|sw5e-phb} and {@item pocket scrambler|sw5e-phb}.

{@b Respirator Mode:} This includes a basic {@item respirator|sw5e-phb} that grants {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid being {@condition poisoned|sw5e-phb} and {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage.

entries: {@b Side Effect:} This complex interface causes significant interference with other communication devices, rendering them impossible to use. While this implant is installed, you can not use any portable device used for communication or jamming, such as a {@item commlink|sw5e-phb} or {@item holotrace device|sw5e-phb}.

{@i Frequently used by scouts and corporate espionage specialists, this imposing implant covers nearly the entire left half of the face, and includes a series of tools for long-term survival in hostile conditions.}

item.name: {@skill Survival} and Surveillance Implant Mk II
entries: This augmentation replaces your eyes and face.

This implant contains several improved tools for long-term survival and reconnaissance. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate one of the below modes that enable you to use several of these tools at once. Only one mode can be active at a time.

items: {@b Communications Mode:} This communications suite includes a {@item headcomm|sw5e-phb} with a scrambler that automatically encodes messages sent to a specified recipient {@item commlink|sw5e-phb} or receiver. While this mode is active, you cannot be {@condition deafened|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, if you listen to any spoken language for 10 minutes, the software in this package will begin to attempt to decipher it. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Lore}) check, DC determined by the GM depending on the rarity of the language. On a success, you can understand the spoken form of this language, and speak it if your species' vocal capabilities allow for it.

{@b Interceptor Mode:} This is a jamming and electronic warfare suite that includes a {@item comm jammer|sw5e-phb}, a {@item holotrace device|sw5e-phb} and {@item Pocket scrambler|sw5e-phb|pocket scrambler}. Additionally, you can attempt to listen in on nearby audio communications chatter such as from a {@item commlink|sw5e-phb} or {@item holocomm|sw5e-phb} as an action. Make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology}) check, DC determined by the GM depending on the sophistication of the technology. On a success, you can hear electronic communications originating from within 100 feet.

{@b Respirator Mode:} This includes a basic {@item respirator|sw5e-phb} that grants {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid being {@condition poisoned|sw5e-phb} and {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage. Additionally, you do not need air to breathe, allowing you to {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb|survive} even in vacuum for up to 1 hour.

entries: {@b Side Effect:} This complex interface causes significant interference with other communication devices, rendering them impossible to use. While this implant is installed, you can not use any portable device used for communication or jamming, such as a {@item commlink|sw5e-phb} or {@item holotrace device|sw5e-phb}.
{@i This sleek, stark white device adorned with a small antenna attaches to the back of the otherwise bulky S3 module.}

item.name: Tihaar
entries: This colorless spirit, favored by Mandalorians, burns the mouth and throat when consumed. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d3} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and at the start of each of the creature's turns it gains {@dice 2d3} temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 10 minutes, during which they must roll a {@dice d3} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Constitution, and for the duration their current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by {@dice 2d3}. If this would reduce your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} below 1, it instead becomes 1. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 14 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

entries: Underwater respirators are worn over the mouth and lower face. While worn, you can breath underwater, as the {@item Respirator|sw5e-phb|respirator} filters the water to create breathable oxygen. The {@item Respirator|sw5e-phb|respirator} functions for 1 hour per {@item power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 2 hours) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}.

item.name: Vambraces of the Outrider
entries: This item can hold a number of charges equal to half your scout level (rounded up). When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, this item regains all missing charges. When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st level or higher, you can expend one or more charges to reduce the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}'s cost by 1 per {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} spent, to a minimum of 1.

When you reach 5th level in scout, you can maintain two targets of your Ranger's Quarry feature, instead of one. Additionally, the reload value of the {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} increases by 1, to 2.

When you reach 11th level in scout, when you are forced to make a {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} check by the target of your Ranger's Quarry, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check and add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. Additionally, the reload value of the {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} increases by 1, to 3.

When you reach 17th level in scout, when you miss with a tech or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, the target takes damage equal to the attack's governing ability modifier. If the target of the attack is the target of your Ranger's Quarry feature, you can choose to deal your Ranger's Quarry damage as well. Additionally, the reload value of the {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb} increases by 1, to 4.

{@i This pair of matching vambraces are inlaid with the etched visage of an eagle. One contains an integrated {@item wristpad|sw5e-phb}, while the other contains an integrated {@item wrist launcher|sw5e-phb}.}

item.name: Vapor projector
entries: The vapor projector does not make {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. Rather than traditional {@item power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, the vapor projector uses specialized projector tanks, which, when fired, spray an area with the contents of the tank.

Projector tanks require your target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the tank's effects. It can have different ammunition types loaded simultaneously, and you can choose which ammunition you're using as you fire it (no action required). If you don't meet the vapor projector's strength requirement, creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. If you lack proficiency in the vapor projector, you must roll the damage dice twice and take the lesser total.

item.name: Vayerbok
entries: Vayerbok is a thick, green, vegetable-based alcoholic beverage typically served hot. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that allows them to roll an additional {@dice d3} when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 10 minutes, during which they must roll a {@dice d3} and subtract the result when making an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Wisdom. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 14 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.

item.name: Venomous Oscillator
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can coat this weapon in a thin layer of {@item poison|sw5e-phb} for 1 minute. The next time you hit with the weapon, the creature must make a DC 15 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d10} {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage and becomes {@condition poisoned|sw5e-phb} for 1 minute.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

item.name: Ventilation Stabilizer
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action and hit a creature with this weapon, you can repeat the attack against another creature within 5 feet, no action required. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

item.name: Verpine Auto-Shielding Unit
entries: While wearing this {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} generator, you can speak its command word as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to cause it to animate. The {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} projects into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} remains animated for 1 minute, until you use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to end this effect, or until you are {@condition incapacitated|sw5e-phb} or die, at which point the {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield} deactivates.
{@i The pinnacle of Verpine scientists' shameless theft of ancient Arkanian energy shield designs.}

item.name: Vitapac (Basic)
entries: This fast-acting syringe grants a revitalizing boost. As an action, you can use this vitapac to restore expended Hit Dice to a beast or humanoid within 5 feet. The creature immediately regains two Hit Dice. If the creature has spent Hit Dice of different sizes, determine which Hit Dice are restored randomly.

item.name: Vocoder (Basic)
entries: A vocoder is an adjustment to a droid's speech center. The vocoder includes five languages, and grants the droid the ability to speak, read, and write each language. The languages can be changed out while interfaced with a protocol droid or appropriate computer.

item.name: Water suit
entries: Water suits are sealed suits that prevent water from getting in or out. Additionally, while wearing a water suit, you can breath underwater, as the suit filters the water to create breathable oxygen.

entries: You have a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and deal an additional {@damage 1d10} damage with this enhanced weapon.

item.name: Weapon (Exceptional)

item.name: Weapon (Improved)

item.name: Weapon Integration Armoring
entries: You can integrate a single weapon that weighs no more than 8 lb. into this armor. While integrated, that weapon gains the hidden property. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being disarmed.

item.name: Will Enhancer Mk I
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.
{@b Side Effect:} When you fail a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you treat the damage as if the source had rolled the maximum.

{@b Side Effect:} When you fail a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you treat the damage as if the source had rolled the maximum.

{@b Side Effect:} When you fail a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you treat the damage as if the source had rolled the maximum.

entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

entries: Your level of proficiency in Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} increases by three steps (to {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}, from trained to mastery, from proficient to high mastery, or from {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} to grand mastery).

{@b Side Effect:} One ability score other than Wisdom (chosen by the GM) decreases by 1.

item.name: Wrist-Mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|Grappling Hook}
entries: You craft a wrist-mounted {@item grappling hook|sw5e-phb} weapon attached to a tightly coiled cord. With this grappler, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d4} kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the hook. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the hook. Removing the hook requires a DC 13 Strength check. While the hook is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While the hook is deployed, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is your size or larger. A creature or object smaller than you is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the hook as an action.

item.name: Yaladai
entries: Yaladai is a powerful stimulant that grants extreme clarity, improving relaxation and focus. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next minute, the creature experiences a high that increases their current and maximum force points by {@dice 2d3}. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or experience a low that lasts 10 minutes, their current and maximum force points are reduced by {@dice 2d3}. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist addiction.
